reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.5 Acting/Cast 4.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers The plot was disjointed I watched this on Song Yujia marathon drama last year and found out she collaborated with Wang Dao Tie..It's really hard to give a review. I can't say it's good, and I can't say it's bad. The premises was quite good but this drama feel disjointed about ML backstory and FL backstory seems not to be match. Surprisingly, I found Wang Daotie to be much better in the drama. He looks younger in here. From the ML perspective, FL is too saintly. She always tries to run away, betrays ML's love, and even causes the death of ML's sister. In fact, because of FL's series of actions, you can empathize with the ML and feel sorry for him. But ML is real villain. He's not an undercover agent; he's the head of a criminal organization leader. So, it's not wrong for FL to try everything to escape. ML runs human trafficking organization and FL happened to check on the case. It was quite unfortunate case in this drama. They used to much darker filter in this drama and it's not looking good. title: Xue Ran Jiang Yue
also_known_as: Blood Ignites the River and the Moon
synopsis: Lin Shu Yue, the eldest daughter of the Lin family, was believed by the outside world to have suffered intellectual impairment after a fire, becoming someone easily manipulated by others. In reality, she possesses the Hidden Mountain Clan’s unique healing bloodline, and her mother and fellow clanspeople all perished in that very fire. For ten years, she has pretended to have amnesia while secretly investigating the dark secrets behind Lin Family Pharmaceuticals, meticulously planning her revenge. Jiang Jin, the power holder of the Jiang family, appears cold and ruthless on the surface, but has long been investigating the problems surrounding Lin Family Pharmaceuticals. Driven by their own motives, the two cross paths. Through mutual probing and cooperation, amid truth, schemes, and strategic mind games, a relationship gradually develops between them—one that transcends mere mutual benefit. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Gothic fantasy about blood, magic elixir and true love I discovered this drama when I was doing a reddit assignment on Xie Yu Wang. Darn, both Xie Yu Wang and Han Jia Hui are my favourites so I was excited about this drama. I watched it last night and wow, I was surprised.What I liked:1. Fantasy - I never thought this could be a fantasy drama - I liked the fantasy element a lot. Magic blood and its healing properties. Experimentation for an elixir.2. Romance - Yes, finally a ML having a spring dream. That dream was spicy and it made sense why he had that dream. They had a rocky relationship with their circumstance going against them but I enjoyed their love story. 3. ML characterisation - I liked that ML got curious about FL and figured out her secret in the first act. Then he offered a partnership deal to FL. He too had a mission to accomplish.4. FL characterisation - She's a complex character. She had to put on a mask to save herself from being exploited. In third act, she was conflicted between revenge and love. Good character growth.5. Acting - It's good to see Han Jia Hui in a dramatic role - she challenged herself. Xie Yu Wang played his role well too. I liked the chemistry between them - there was a tacit understanding and strong sexual tension between them.6. Styling - Great outfits worn by ML. I liked most outfits worn by FL except the first dress. The red stains looked like blood and the colour tone - hhhhmm it wasn't a pretty dress to me.What I disliked:1. Abuse - I pitied FL for the abuse she had to endure. I hated that the kids were part of the experiment.2. Antagonists - FL's father was evil. reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers Plot is okay but this is for fans I watch this because of Tiktok ads and I quite have 50:50 feeling about this. The plot is actually Ok since i like revenge drama but i was on mood to torturing myself so i give myself try.The pacing was fast, the storylines were well-developed until 15 minutes of ending and some of the plot twists and climaxes The ML and FL were intelligent and articulate, and most importantly, they were a great match.Personally, i don't fond of Zuo Yi acting because she always look one dimensional character and her mimic is always same when she frown and her acting is not improving compare to her same peer on pioneer era of short drama. Zhang Tingrui has improved a lot compared to his previous drama with Han Yutong. He might be a bit too immature for a domineering CEO role, but he's very suitable for this kind of younger, competitive, and scheming character. The chemistry between the leads still sufficient to keep me watching this.The show was average, but I didn't like the ending; it had to be a complete mess and fall into generic formula. reviews.author: TTR - The Truth Review
reviews.review_text: Overall 2.0 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 2.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers If you enjoy watching heroes suffer for 90% of the show, this is for you Not good. The show is poor, but at least it was watchable. The FL is looking to infiltrate the new Dynasty to avenge her families massacre and the ML is a spy from the previous dynasty undercover. They go from enemies to lovers but are constantly on the back foot while the villains plan and scheme relentlessly to torture and murder innocents. What really bothers me with this type of show is the usual nonsense where villains like the adopted daughter who decide to redeem themselves are forgiven for all their crimes and face no accountability and have a happy ending and when the villains do get their comeuppance. It’s usually short and sharp and they die instantly where they’ve made the heroes suffer horrendous agony over a long period of time while they’ve been living in luxury and happiness . This kind of perverse pleasure in watching heroes suffer for 90% is quite disturbing and I don’t understand how Chinese audiences enjoy this kind of thing because there is no emotional satisfaction and the payoff is useless by the end. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Brilliantly written vertical drama about office romance in fashion industry I had never watched Song Chen drama and today I felt like watching his drama. I checked his MDL profile and the drama title caught my attention. Since Jwells mentioned raw video on iQIYI platform, I tried searching on my iQIYI app and voila, found the drama. I must say I was very impressed by the writing & directing elements of this drama.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was fairly new in the city and at the fashion industry but never easily intimidated. I liked her can-do spirit & problem solving capability.2. Writing - OMG this drama gave me US movie Devil Wears Prada vibe but the boss wasn't as aloof as Miranda Priestley. I loved that the drama covers professional & personal challenges in almost equal amount. This drama has depths.3. ML characterisation - ML strived for perfection but he was never cruel to his employees. I liked that he was flawed and slowly his walls were brought down by FL. I also liked that he was a self-made successful fashion editor-in-chief.4. Romance - Slowburn but satisfying. There were many sweet moments and good kisses. There is an almost spicy scene haha you know how it goes in vertical dramas.5. Acting - I was impressed by Song Chen & Kan Zi Yi's performance. KZY's FL was endearing and SC was cool & emptionally restraint at first but showed some vulnerability as the story progressed.6. Styling - Impeccable in particular ML's outfits. Damn he looked like a supermodel - I liked his height & build! FL and Daisy's clothes were beautiful & chic too.7. Supporting characters - I liked Li Xia the coffee shop owner. ML's brother and childhood friend were likeable too.What I disliked:1. Antagonist - I felt the antagonist's arc was too simplified. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers The Shein version of W Two World The premise is that the female lead travels between a comic book and reality to save the male lead basically carbon copy of K-Drama W Two Worlds (2022).The plot is not smooth enough, actors' acting is average, the dubbing is very uncomfortable to listen. I watched this with 1,25x speed since it was not too engaging as K-Drama. The plot felt rushed as it progressed, with the romance and rebirth storylines feeling like they were fast-forwarded, as if they were rushing to finish because they didn't have enough time. It wasn't explained whether the FL stayed in that world forever, or whether the ML could leave or travel freely.Overall, it's somewhat watchable, but not top-tier. Those who like Zhang Shan and Wang Xuan might consider to watch this. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers This is more leans into political drama. I watched this last year and had this drama on hold for some reason. Decided to watch back and it was decent despite the abrupt ending.This drama really due gender reversal perfectly Woman Rules while Man obeys.The logic and details are reasonable, the plot unfolds naturally, and the pacing is tight and smooth. FL is courageous and resourceful, strategizing meticulously, with interconnected schemes, utilizing all available resources, making no wrong moves, and ultimately achieving a successful comeback, not only avenging her family but also reaching the top. Moreover, this drama is not a pseudo-1vN story so there is no kissing or romantic moment between FL and 3 MLs-even though FL created her own harem. Recommended to watch if you want to watch gender reverse political struggle. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Jwells avisou, corri para assistir hahahah. Dessa vez, vou inverter a ordem das coisas...Gostei do personagem Chen Chuan, amigo do ML, interpretado pelo ator Xu Rui Chen. Ele era o único sensato, gostei do cuidado dele para com a FL e as verdades ditas para o ML em todos os momentos.A mãe do ML, Mrs. Li, eu gostei dela, porque não, ela não se opôs ao relacionamento deles por causa da FL, e sim com o receio dela se ferir no futuro e não ter saída. Ela genuinamente estava preocupada porque o ML nunca tinha demonstrado interesse por ninguém nunca e nem valor as pessoas. Ela sabia a limitação (emocional também) do filho.Já as meninas, que sofreram na mão do 2ML, Liu Wan Yi e a Nuan Nuan, gostei de como elas cuidavam uma da outra.Agora sobre a FL e o ML, Lin Qing Qian e Li Ting Chen, eram personagens extremamente complexos. Era nítido que o Ting Chen se interessou genuinamente pela FL, mas suas palavras eram contrárias, e suas ações eram todas nos bastidores, então a limitação dele não permitiu que a FL enxergasse realmente suas preocupações e seus cuidados. Já Qing Qian, sua infância em um lar com violência doméstica e alcoolismo, a fez jogar o jogo dos ricos, a usar as pessoas, e pelas ações do psicopata do 2ML, se manteve ao lado, mas não era boba. Ela sabia exatamente o que estava fazendo e precisava proteger enquanto coletava provas. Sobre o 2ML, sinceramente, é por isso que eu tenho ranço do ator Gao Wei kkkkkk, raramente ele faz papéis secundários que não sejam malucos da cabeça, abusivos e/ou tóxicos, por isso que todo drama que vejo que ele faz, eu já fico com ansiedade imaginando o pior tipo de personagem hahahah Mas sim, sua atuação neste foi ótima.Há poucas cenas onde ele ou algum outro ator deixou a desejar. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Quiet mystery romance with good chemistry between the leads I was surprised to see a collab between Zhang Chu Xuan and He Cong Rui. Both are my favourite actors. I watched this drama within first 3 days of its release. I enjoyed it.What I liked:1. Tone - I like the quiet mystery element of this drama. The drama is not too dark which is a breath of fresh air.2. FL characterisation - I liked her determination in investigating her sister's death. She was more concerned about truth rather than vengeance. 3. ML characterisation - Gosh he was mysterious that I was praying he's not a baddie. He figured out FL's hidden agenda quite early but he didn't go overboard with confrontation nor meddling.4. Acting - I really enjoy the acting of both ZCX & HCR, individually & as a couple. It's great to see ZCX playing this role (a softer, vulnerable woman) as I've seen her in too many "strong woman" characters. HCR exuded the right allure for this mysterious character.5. Romance - Slow burn because investigation takes precedence. There was good balance of push and pull - sweet & spicy moments. FL begging ML scene was unexpected for me - it was very sweet.6. Styling - ZCX looked beautiful in that floor length dress. I also liked the pink blush dress.What I disliked:1. FL's action - I did feel that FL was stringing ML along and I disliked it. Good thing she didn't take long to fess up.Favourite sceneBathtub Read More Was this review helpful to you?

YEARS OF UNSPOKEN LOVE OVERALL IMPRESSION🌟This was a deeply emotional romance about two people who had secretly loved each other for years, yet remained separated by pride, insecurity, age and social status. Although the story contains intense attraction, jealousy and possessiveness, its emotional centre is Shen Qing Li’s struggle to maintain her dignity and independence while carrying the enormous responsibility of paying for her seriously ill brother’s treatment.WHAT I LIKED💖• As expected, Min Jie was not shy about displaying his beautiful eight-pack, and the drama also delivered plenty of passionate kissing!• Shen Qing Li was poor, young and somewhat naive, but she was never greedy. She showed little interest in expensive gifts or luxury because her priority was earning money for her brother’s medical expenses.• I admired her determination to work for what she needed. Her emotional distance was not indifference; it was her way of protecting her pride, independence and vulnerable heart.• She had quietly loved Gu Heng for years and hoped to reach his social level before pursuing him. After circumstances forced her into a humiliating arrangement with him, she feared that he would never respect her, love her sincerely or consider her his equal.• Gu Heng was extremely difficult to read. He appeared cold and disinterested, yet he was always the first to protect her, pay her debts and create excuses to see her again.• His devotion emerged through actions rather than words. He became increasingly jealous and possessive because he had also loved her for years but was emotionally guarded and terrified of losing her.• I enjoyed their central contradiction: she withdrew because she believed she could never belong in his world, while he held on too tightly because he feared she would disappear from it.WHAT I DISLIKED⚠️• The SML was horribly manipulative. He secretly interfered with the FL’s employment and education to make her dependent on him, while allowing her to believe that Gu Heng was responsible for her suffering.• His behaviour became completely unforgivable when, after feeling rejected, he sold the FL into human trafficking. Whatever sympathy his feelings might once have inspired disappeared at that point.• Gu Heng’s inability to communicate made his genuine devotion appear controlling. Instead of explaining his feelings, he relied on jealousy, possessiveness and forceful actions, which intensified the FL’s fear that he did not respect her.• The ending did not feel quite right. I would have preferred Shen Qing Li to confess while sober so that her decision felt completely deliberate and emotionally satisfying.• Several conflicts and misunderstandings still needed proper resolution, making the final scenes feel abrupt rather than complete.PRODUCTION AND PERFORMANCES🎭• Min Jie effectively balanced Gu Heng’s cold, intimidating exterior with the vulnerability of a man who had secretly loved the FL for years. His protectiveness, jealousy and fear of losing her were visible even when the character refused to communicate.• Liu Xiao Yu gave Shen Qing Li a convincing mixture of pride, resilience, innocence and emotional vulnerability. Her performance helped explain why the FL repeatedly pulled away despite loving him.• The drama’s strongest element was not the external conflict but the emotional difference between how the leads felt and how their behaviour was interpreted. Their love was mutual, yet neither believed it could be safely expressed.FINAL THOUGHTS💭I think this drama is ultimately more about the FL’s independence and personal struggles than a simple “who did what to whom” story. That focus may explain why the ending felt so abrupt: Shen Qing Li’s emotional growth was treated as the destination, even though several relationship issues still needed resolving. I would have preferred a sober confession and a little more time for the leads to discuss their years of misunderstanding. Nevertheless, their shared history transformed the romance into a moving story of mutual secret devotion—she believed she was unworthy of his world, while he had been quietly waiting for her all along. title: Xi Xiu Qiang Wei
also_known_as: Playful Sniffing the Rose , The Scent of Roses , 戲嗅薔薇
synopsis: Rose was originally a cold and ruthless female assassin, but was coerced by Ye Jing Hong into infiltrating the Ye family, becoming a tool in the power struggles of the wealthy. Her target, the eldest young master, turned out to be an upright and warm-hearted gentleman who had saved her life. She was powerless to resist; though unwilling to fall into the trap, she was forced to seduce and entice him. Her conscience remained intact, unwilling to become a viper in the gutter, but Ye Jing Hong relentlessly pressured her. When she had exhausted all her resources and was on the verge of escaping, she suddenly realized that the mastermind behind it all was none other than the unwavering love in her heart! Ye Jing Hong, on the other hand, appeared outwardly righteous but inwardly treacherous. Thus, her pure heart was tainted, and the world seemed to collapse in an instant. But all the conspiracies and schemes had already been laid out; could everything be reversed? (Source: r/DramaRush Reddit) English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 10 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers Might be the odd one out, but I just really like this one. This, and "My One and Only" are the two picks I regularly rewatch. IMO, no contest, the best of the adaptations. None of the casting was found wanting. Incredible performance by Yin Yibo ~ exceptional character nuance and detail. He really does about as much as possible with this character. Story is complete and flows so smoothly there's almost a dreamlike quality. Oh... The music gets a 10 for not being annoying.A lot of subtle reveals amongst the obvious events. It's made clear that, with the marriage cancelled, Shen Nan Zhi's place in the family and social status is considered null. Jiang Jin Nian, the elder brother, is totally protective of that not happening. However, it's shown that he's always been aware of, and caring for Nanzhi; just respectful of roles and boundaries. Although claiming no foundation of feelings, he virtually leaps at the opportunity to marry her. He's returned from abroad, relocated the company headquarters, and embraces the marriage without giving any quarter.The YouTube link I currently use: https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=vlejYSGorgk&pp=0gcJCTMBo7VqN5tD. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Apesar de ter atores que eu adoro muito, essa adaptação - apesar de ser a segunda melhor versão deste web novel - não chega nem aos pés da química e naturalidade do casal em "Kisses of Sweet Passion", lá parece tudo se encaixar perfeitamente, já aqui parece que a atriz e o ator não estavam tão confortáveis nas cenas de mais intimidade.Percebi que minha lembrança em relação a este drama era falha quando escrevi a resenha da adaptação citada a cima, então reassisti ao constatar também que não havia resenha para tal e minha nota originalmente era 4. O 2ML aqui parece muito birrento, apesar de seguir o mesmo roteiro das demais, já a FL travada e o ML um pouco mais intenso, porém frio. Mas os pais da família Jiang também são bons aqui. FL characterisation - She was a hardworking, single mum. Even though she struggled in meeting ends meet, she held on to her values & integrity. Li Tian Yuan was convincing enough for the role.2. ML characterisation - He was warm, respectful & protective of his family. I liked Zhang Yi Lun's acting in this drama.3. Romance - Slow burn. Supporting characters - ML's mother was great for her warmth & kindness towards FL.What I disliked:1. The child casting - It's amusing that the kid seemed big (like aged 1-1.5 years) in the first scene then gradually grew younger. By the time ML met him, the kid looked like a 6 month old child. 2. I check if i have seen this Huang Yunyun drama while i actually have seen that and realized i had seen this drama last year since i am not quite familiar with Jin Wang face (forgive my face blindness).Plot is about Twins are born and the Taoist said that twin flowers blooming together are a calamity for the Prime Minister's family. One of the girls is destined to be a phoenix, other one is destined to bad luck. FL family throw they baby into the cliff. FL was saved by Taoist master. In order to obtain the purple energy, she drugged and kidnapped ML l to escape a calamity, she sexually assaults the ML, causing him to become infertile—and then runs away with twins. ML legs was quite healed after that-but he pretends to being disabled for political purpose.The only one who suffers the most from beginning to end is the ML. He tells the FL, "I know you'll run away, but even though I'm not as strong as you, I'll still chase after you. You know I have the ability to chase you." Fortunately, the FL is eventually won over. ML is quite respectful to FL choice even he can force her but he knows FL more than FL itself. Luckily ML had the twins as his cupid over FL. The twins are quite smart and wise children.There is no misunderstanding between the leads ML knows the real FL so there is no identity mistake. I like the ending for every characters in there, they got deserve ending. synopsis: The story is about Chinese students at the prestigious Ivy League college. The efforts they made to get accepted, when just being gifted students isn't enough; their experiences, struggles, relationships, and the blend of Chinese-Western cultures while studying there. Gu Nian planned to study abroad because she wanted to be with her foreign boyfriend for a long time. Without any experience in studying abroad, she enrolled in a studying abroad agency, LZ, on the net but had a dispute with the company's owner, Lin Yao, and her boyfriend, Zhuo Peng. The reason was that Lin Yao took Gu Nian's order even though the company was short of staff. Zhuo Peng, who was a legal entity but did not work in the company, was forced to become Gu Nian's temporary tutor and helped her become a university student. Shortly afterwards, Lin Yao and Zhuo Peng broke up. Zhuo Peng was hired as a psychological counselor at the University of A. He found that the international student community has some psychological, life, and academic problems due to the uncomfortable environment. That's why Zhuo Peng set up a free consultancy service to help students find the right school for them. This goal also coincided with Gu Nian's. In the end, they became partners and a couple. synopsis: Lin Qing Hui was once the pampered daughter of the wealthy Lin family, living a life of luxury and privilege—until, at thirteen, she discovered she was not their real daughter. After the true heiress, Lin Wan Wan, returned home, she stole everyone’s love and affection, even Lu Chen, Qing Hui’s childhood sweetheart, who abandoned her for power and status. At Lin Wan Wan’s college celebration when Lin Qing Hui was eighteen, Wan Wan pushed the Fu family’s heiress down the stairs, leaving her in a coma, and framed Qing Hui for the crime. reviews.author: Rhody401
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 Apologize for a lie This drama begins with one betrayal after another, and I really felt for Lin Qing Hui. She grows up believing she is the treasured daughter of the Lin family, only to discover at thirteen that she isn't their biological child. Once Lin Wan Wan returns, Qing Hui slowly loses the family, love, and life she once knew.But what happened when she was eighteen was unforgivable.Lin Wan Wan pushes the Fu family's heiress down the stairs and then frames Qing Hui. Instead of someone finally standing beside her, even her childhood sweetheart Lu Chen betrays her. The man who once knew and cared about her chooses power and status, then goes even further by giving false testimony in court that sends an innocent Qing Hui to **prison for ten years**.For me, that is where Lu Chen crosses a line that regret alone cannot erase. This wasn't simply a misunderstanding or him failing to believe her. He actively participated in destroying her life.Qing Hui loses her freedom and ten years she can never get back because the people around her chose themselves over the truth. That makes her character especially compelling because after everything taken from her, I wanted to see what kind of woman would eventually walk out of that prison.You can apologize for a lie. You can regret choosing the wrong person. But how do you give someone back ten stolen years of their life? 💔This story definitely made me want to see Qing Hui reclaim everything that was taken from her. synopsis: Former major tech company executive Yan Xi Zhi spends eight years in marriage living like an oppressed live-in maid, enduring insults from her mother-in-law and cold treatment from her husband, Shen Shu Chen. After unexpectedly gaining the ability to see “on-screen comments,” she learns that she is a tragic character and that Shen Shu Chen has already sent out a divorce agreement. Yan Xi Zhi goes to Hai City to finalize the divorce. On the way, she unexpectedly has a relationship with Huo Yan Ting, the president of the Huo Group, who suffers from misogyny—and she turns out to be the “cure” for his condition. Afterward, she goes to Shen Shu Chen’s company to confront him over the divorce, expose his pretense, and begin her path to seek justice. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Leads were newcomers but wow their chemistry was sizzling. Kisses better than the other version This drama appeared on one of my favourite youtube channels. I randomly clicked on thumbnail to read comments - generally positive. Decided to watch it on Monday afternoon to destress. This is another version of She Is the Only One starring Zhao Jia & Chen Si. I must say I enjoyed this one more than the more famous version.What I liked:1. Acting - Gao Hai Zhou & Peng Hui Ying are both new to the industry but individually they did alright in their roles. However as a couple, I'd say their chemistry is sizzling. They seemed hot for each other. I also liked the height difference with Gao Hai Zhou always bending when he kissed Peng Hui Ying.2. Romance - Damn hot kisses 🔥. There were many kisses and physical touch was definitely their love language. There were sweet moments like ML cooking for FL and them talking about their relationship.3. FL characterisation - I also liked the FL in this version compared to the other version. She never once saw ML as sugar daddy or an escape from her situation.4. Styling - Despite being low budget, I liked most of the clothes worn by FL and ML. 5. Visuals - Wow, Peng Hui Ying was gorgeous! Gao Hai Zhou had this facial features that remind me of a Korean. Both are definitely striking.6. ML characterisation - He was Mr Nice Guy overall. I liked that he respected FL in her decision making. Never meddled except that help for smoother divorce process. I also liked that he had his personal battle to overcome.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's ex husband & mother-in-law were nasty. Pity ML for having to deal with selfish mother and her relative.2. Make-up - FL seemed to be wearing foundation a shade lighter than her skin tone. Obvious when you compare her face and the neck.3. First meet - It was odd that ML barged into FL's hotel room then kissed her. He blamed on being drugged but hhhhmm coerced sex is not sexy.Favourite sceneWhen FL & ML were in the kitchen Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Plot is nonsense but the leads chemistry are on lit. I watched this after watching Chen Si and Zhao Jia version and the chemistry between the leads was better in here even the kisses were better in here too. The acting was quite decent for the newcomers (The FL is :Peng Huiying and the ML is Gao Haizhou. But the plot is still doesn't make sense given that the drama started with ML drugged and entering FL's room and they have sex while FL still not processing her divorce. The online dialogue between scenes is really annoying for me. It's a pity the drama is too drawn out and the ending feels rushed.Worth to watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers Easy, light, and funny watch Hilarious plot about a girl pretending to be a prince in the palace. Trying his/her very best to not be in the race for thr throne only to accidentally end up front and center in the race. One of my favorite bits from this show is the relationship between the mother and daughter/FL. Prior to the invention of vaccines most children didnt live past 5 so they held no value and the parents didnt get attached to them until they knew they would survive. Generally this was in their teen years and because of age maturity/timing it was also when they got married. Point being: parent and child relationships weren't established well back then so it was nice seeing a Queen/mother who realized it was not her child but took her in and genuinely loved her anyway. Rant done. This was a nice relaxing one. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers A tale of rebirth with martial art lessons, comic relief and romantic twists I was preparing for a reddit post on Xie Yu Wang's dramas and this drama was one of the new releases. I decided to watch for the assignment and wow, I didn't expect to enjoy it so much. I even included in my list of Top 5 Xie Yu Wang dramas.What I liked:1. Tone - Reborn tale with comedic twist. FL was always in scenarios that provided comic relief. There were dramatic / serious scenes in the second half of the drama and they were done well.2. Setup - The drama showed differences between traditionalist vs modern / Western mindset and I enjoyed those scenes.3. FL characterisation - She was repented of her past behaviour towards ML. I liked that she was feisty and charming.4. Romance - Arranged marriage with frosty dynamic between the leads. After rebirth, FL tried to win over ML's heart. I liked that FL initiated dates with him. There were several tender & romantic moments and a few spicy scenes.5. ML characterisation - . ML was a Mr Nice Guy who wanted to believe in the best of FL but past bad deeds made him doubt her.6. Martial arts - ML was a martial art practitioner and I loved those scenes in the dojo. The lessons were entertaining and somewhat romantic. The use of English was amusing.7. Styling - Loved ML's outfits. I favoured FL's traditional outfits.What I disliked:1. Styling - FL's Western gowns felt out of place, I find. Some dresses were unflattering.2. Antagonists - FL's former paramour was pathetic and disrespectful. The maid's daughter was delusional & rude. Their scheming was unbelievable.Favourite sceneWhen FL & ML made love for the first time Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Azet
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 10 Rewatch Value 8.0 A Marriage in Turmoil- The Main leads had a serious issue of communication issues, they only communicated in bed at ehmm nights but there were never real tokens and showing of affection or even care at day times, although the husband did secretly stuff to his wife`s sake. Still, she had no idea that he is madly in love with her which was obvious to all the other people around them. She wants divorce and he refuses to give it to her, so it becomes a battle of wills between this married couple...and ahhh the ever evident sexual tension is always there! The actors did a great job in portraying their emotional depth and their struggle to honestly communicating without the fear and pride stopping them. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 6.5 This review may contain spoilers Still the best adaptation. I watched this since i like Dong Yi, he basically embraced the scumbag role and Shi Tong acting was quite okay but not to make you gasped. The chemistry between them was weak than Zhang Yiyang-Sun Lulu version but this version was still okay compared to Wang Gege and Zhao Zhendong one.The plot is mainly about misunderstand between the two people who clearly love each other constantly test each other's feelings. It's very engaging, not just boringly quiet. Furthermore, ML's process of falling in love is portrayed very subtly; it's really hard to tell that he's fallen in love. Overall, if you disregard the awkward romantic relationship between the ML and FL, it's still acceptable.The best person in this drama is the FL mother-in-law. Even after the ML and FL divorce, the mother-in-law still wants to recognize the FL as her goddaughter.If you want to see better adaptation watch this or Zhang Yiyang one. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Must see romantic suspense drama with great acting and fiery chemistry I discovered this drama when I was going through Huang Bo's filmography to update his MDL profile. This drama's synopsis intrigued me. I enjoyed this drama a lot and could watch this drama on repeat.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was a drone developer. Great to see a female scientist in vertical dramas. She was smart to use her strength to save herself in difficult situations. Lun Rui Xue impressed me with her acting.2. Romance - At first the relationship between FL and ML was more physical for survival but it's great to see it transition to love as both trusted and depended on each other to catch the villain and get out of that place. This is one of few dramas in which main couple works together on a common goal. There were hot kisses and sexy seduction.3. ML characterisation - A complex character wonderfully portrayed by Huang Bo. ML is anti-hero trapped in an undercover mission waiting to finish and get out. I liked that I couldn't read him at first.4. Antagonists - There are two types of antagonists: FL's family and the people behind human trafficking & drug smuggling. Both types were nicely developed though I wish there was more screentime for the mastermind behind the those big crimes.5. Legacy - Legacy is one of the themes explored in this drama and I liked how it was written in many ways such as from perseptives of FL, ML and antagonists. 6. Fitness - I have been into keeping myself fit after a health scare. So I appreciate whenever a drama has scenes of physical training & fitness. Appreciated that this was shown as part of main couple's preparation to bring down the mastermind.What I disliked:1. Abuse - This story involves human trafficking which for me is hard to watch. reviews.author: Rhody401
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 He lost her twice I enjoyed the idea behind this drama, but I'm disappointed with the versions being uploaded because important scenes have been cut—including parts necessary to understand the actual ending. Without them, viewers are missing some of the biggest revelations in the story.Fu Ting Shi eventually discovers that Luo Jing Xue really died that night and was given a second chance at life, but at the cost of her ability to love. He also learns that Song Nan Qiao had been faking her illness and that even the gunshot she supposedly took for him was arranged as part of her plan to eventually marry him.For me, Fu Ting Shi was a weak-minded ML, and much of what happened between him and the 2nd FL was **his own fault**. He allowed himself to be manipulated, but he also made his own choices. After four years with Jing Xue, he secretly married another woman. By the time he understood the truth and what he had thrown away, it was far too late.Luo Jing Xue, however, was my favorite part of the drama. She was always a strong woman—love was what weakened her. Once that emotional bond was removed, we finally saw who she could be when she stopped living for Fu Ting Shi. She knew what she wanted, made decisions for herself, and accepted her second chance at life.That's what made her rebirth so satisfying. Fu Ting Shi wanted reconciliation, but some betrayals shouldn't disappear simply because the person who caused them finally feels regret.He lost her twice—the first time through his choices, and the second time because she no longer had the love that once made her stay. 💔🔥 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Amarina
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 The Most Entertaining Headache You'll Ever Have Never has a show more made me stop and go: "I have absolutely NO idea what's happening right now, but I am INVESTED." Things that will put some people off regardless of anything else... 1. Some of the costumes and set pieces look like they came from Wish. I personally don't care as much about these things and even I noticed how low budget they looked.2. The camera shakes in some scenes and may cause motion sickness or headaches.3. CGI is standard very low budget effects. This said, the show has an interesting premise of having the FL needing to face off against her past self, this time in the body of the "good" sister. There ends up being a LOT more to the story than just this initial set-up and for the most part everything is rather detailed without any dropped threads... but where it becomes a test of comprehension skills is that there are a LOT of flashbacks. Indeed, some flashbacks look so much like the current scene and last for so long it becomes easy to forget if you're watching something in the past or present. Another issue becomes the storyline of the ML and his love for the sister and the FL in the past. With overlapping time lines there were multiple instances when I wished they would have made past it's own portion and THEN moved the show into the present instead of doing all the flashbacks. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers It was more depth than common revenge drama I was quite happy to see Ma Le Jie and Chen Gang acting in this drama.Based on the synopsis, I thought it was just a typical revenge-themed drama, but after watching half of it, I realized it wasn't that simple. FL emotional is well-developed, far superior to typical revenge dramas. The only thing that can hurt her is the behavior of the ML (after all, she loved him deeply and wasn't completely disappointed, so it's understandable).Even when FL patience and love to ML are completely gone, and she's pregnant, she resolutely refuses to turn back, her only thought being to keep the child and leave the father.The mistress isn't your average mistress (I won't spoil it here; you'll find it more interesting to watch), and the SML also has his own love interest. The supporting characters aren't stereotypical or merely tools, making the drama's scope far greater than typical revenge dramas. The pacing is tight and smooth, the network of relationships is vast and complex, the characters are well-developed, and the plot is full of twists and turns, making it captivating. I really like the ending it was refreshing. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: As the mistress of the general’s household, Shen Zhao endures constant difficulty from her mother-in-law and provocation from a scheming woman. She bears everything quietly, only hoping to use the general’s influence to clear the name of her family, who were unjustly exiled. One night, she and General Chu Mu unexpectedly switch bodies. From then on, the situation is completely reversed. Experiencing life in the inner household firsthand, Chu Mu comes to understand her hardships and begins to support her authority, while Shen Zhao, using Chu Mu’s identity as a general, investigates clues about her father’s unjust case within both court and military circles. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers Illogical plot and scriptwriter loves bad guys. I watching this drama because of Song Yujia compared to her previous drama, this drama was quite letdown in term of plot. I don't mind with soul swapping theme but the problem of this drama lies with the character logic. The chemistry between Xong Yujia and Ling Xuan was really good but the plot and character hold the problem.ML character has major plot holes. He's clearly had a long-standing crush on the FL, yet he treats her coldly after marriage. He was initially moved by her kindness, but he easily believes the slanderous accusations leveled against her by his wicked mother-in-law and others. How the scriptwriter comes with idea ML betrays FL father to protect FL family?FL also has questionable part. Before marriage, she had absolutely no feelings for the ML. It was an arranged marriage, and she suffered for several years. How could she possibly fall in love with him in the end? There is no backstory about FL was infuriated with ML and suddenly she in love with ML.Female villain caused so much trouble, only to be kicked out of the mansion in the end? And FL even had to give her money out of blue? FL mother-in-law didn't get any punishment either. This screenwriter really loves villains! The plot is also full of holes. FLs father is just a minister, not a prince, not a general, not even a prime minister. Why emperor want to kill FL father? I guess the screenwriter couldn't come up with a plausible reason.Only watchable for hardcore fans. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Cunning FL who punish her tormentors after rebirth I came across this drama on reddit. I was curious because reddit or YouTube users claimed that this is a good revenge drama. I watched it yesterday. I quite liked it but felt it was missing something.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She vowed to punish those who tortured her in her previous life. After rebirth, she was tenacious & cunning but put on soft & delicate exterior to ensure successful execution of her plans. I liked that! 2. Revenge - I liked her scheming because she played with the main antagonist's mind. 3. Kisses - Romancing the prince was part of her plan and damn she was good. Her seduction shocked me and hahaha I think the prince got excited because of that element.4. Comeuppance - Glad that Shen You Rue and the prince got the punishment they deserved.5. Duration - About 102 minutes so it was a quick watch. What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Shen You Rue was batshit crazy and cruel. The prince was a narcissist.2. Familiarity - I watched too many female-pov revenge dramas set in historical time. So around the third act I felt bored because it was the same "fighting with antagonist" vibe.Favourite sceneWhen FL delivered water to the prince after her rebirth Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Not overacting green tea ML This is one of Duan Meiyang best drama for me. I watch many his drama but all of his drama is not really good because too many bad plot and direction. I never thought Song Yujia suits Duan Meiyang and their chemistry is not disappointing since DMY have kind of younger brother vibe despite both actor born on the same year. DMY plays green tea ML was my favorite even he didn't beat Wang Peiyan throne.The Plot is about FL who is already to finalize their divorce to her business marriage husband. Of course they keep the divorce secret for business. ML didn't know FL divorce try to climb into her room and then thought they had an affair. The Pseudo Infidelity plot is not dragged too long so there is no repeat action on the couple behavior. ML was willingly to being a mistress since he fell in love with FL for a long time. FL ex husband is not too scumbag compared to other drama (he didn't cheat) but he is just realized he already fell in love with FL.The ending was well-deserved.Recommended to watch for Duan Meiyang fans. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers A atriz Song Yu Jia tem um perfil um pouco maduro do que o ator Duan Mei Yang em suas feições mesmo sendo um ano mais nova que ele na vida real, mas no drama ele a chama de jiejie, então gostei que ela realmente parecia muito mais madura que ele, que era tão impulsivo. Apesar do figurino limitado de ambos, o drama é divertido de acompanhar, mas acho que se estendeu demais a FL escondendo a verdade do ML. A princípio foi engraçado vê-la provocar constantemente ele, mas depois de quase 1 hora e meia se tornou repetitivo e nem sempre ela demonstrava o amar tanto assim, porque o perfil do ML era bem descarado kkkkk Mas gostei dos dois atores contracenando juntos. O Duan Mei Yang fica bem em atuar como ML cachorrinhoO 2ML foi egoísta e ridículo, e apesar de achar besta o motivo da mãe do ML se opor ao casamento dos dois anteriormente, como não houve muita interferência dela na história em si, foi ok de digerir... synopsis: Eight years ago, Ye Hong Yu, the last Hellbringer, nearly died in a massacre. Her rescuer: Gu Xi Yan, a charismatic but ruthless man with secrets as dark as hell itself. To repay him, she swore a forbidden cosmic oath: she'd forgive him 101 times, no matter how much he hurt her. For years, she was loyal, bore his daughter, and endured his icy indifference. But Gu Xi Yan's "salvation" was a lie—he'd secretly sold her soul for power. Now, with the 101st betrayal complete, Hong Yu's Hellbringer powers are fully awakened. Stripped of love, brimming with divine wrath, she begins reclaiming her soul, piece by piece, from demons born of Gu Xi Yan's sins in the underworld. Each kill is a step closer to vengeance, not just for herself, but for every soul he betrayed. "She gave him a daughter. He gave her damnation. Now she’s the end of his story." reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Familiar plot & odd kissing scenes - my least favourite out of 4 versions I wanted to watch more Aorigele's dramas because I really liked his acting in After the Fake Play Became Real, He Lost His Love Forever. I watched the raw version (no English subs) of this drama because I was already familiar with the story having seen a few stories with "my husband wants me to be impregnated by another man" plot: i) Shi Tong, ii) Zhang Shan, iii) Wei Fan Shu. This is my least favourite version.What I liked:1. Main characters - They are like FL & ML in other versions of this plot but less lusty. 2. Aorigele - I liked watching him play a Mr Nice Guy who's devoted to his lady. He has a great body and I like the shot of his back.3. Acting - Both Cui Shi Yi and Aorigele gave good performance and there was chemistry despite the odd kissing scenes.What I disliked:1. Kissing - Ok I know Aorigele does kissing scene so I had some expectation considering other versions of this plot are quite steamy. I was disappointed. Aorigele clearly kissed his hand / thumb. This is my first drama of Cui Shi Yi so I wonder if she opts for "no kissing" policy.2. Antagonist - FL's husband was stupid to allow other man to touch his wife and then became jealous when she did in fact get pregnant. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 1.5 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Quite refreshing to see twins as ML but the plot *shake head* I absolutely have to support Peng Yao's new drama! And the male lead is actually a pair of twins not the double lead of one actor. Quite refreshing.Liu Chen Jin and Liu Chen Rui, who played the twins—one charmingly wicked, the other deeply affectionate—My face blindness are too severe in this drama. So I can based from their attitude and it quite works. The chemistry between Peng Yao and Liu Chenjin is sufficient. Plot is quite believable since she cannot differentiate the twins (me too) even from their attitude and slowly she can distinguish the twins and it gradually becomes clear. After learning that she is pregnant, ML began to protects her.The ending is bittersweet and well-deserved even though i feel it was too dramatic.Personally think this is a work that I wouldn't watch repeatedly Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Era para ser 5 / 5.5 no máximo, mas eu tô boazinha hoje então vou subir um pouco kkkkkPor quê? Porque acho que é a primeira vez em um drama vertical que realmente eram gêmeos atuando e não o mesmo ator se desdobrando para fazer as cenas com aqueles dublês que, infelizmente, não ficam parecidos quando estão juntos em cena hahahahEles são completamente idênticos, então só a postura mais madura e os figurinos/penteados do personagem nos fazem conseguir distinguir entre os atores Liu Zi Hao e o Liu Wei Hao.Não gostei muito da atuação da Peng Yao aqui, nas cenas mais íntimas de beijo, enquanto o ator Zi Hao dava a vida, ela com a boca :| hahahah. E sabemos bem que ela atua bem, seja nessa hora ou não, pode ser uma questão mesmo da produção? Pode, mas atrapalha...O drama em si é uma mescla daquele que vemos que o ML é envenenado e precisa se curar transando 3x com a FL kkkk, mas aqui tem o adendo do irmão gêmeo, a conspiração da família Bai e etc, então fica um pouco mais interessante e o drama é curto, então tudo se resolve rapidamente, estendendo apenas um pouco mais na parte da FL não descobrir que há 2 e não um Pei kkkkkMas para um CEO ele é meio burro né? reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Thrilling revenge drama set in the world of fine art. Great chemistry & acting I am a fan of Sheng Yi Jie and Yu Long so I was delighted to see both of them together in a drama. I watched this drama on the day of its release.What I liked:1. Romance - Good balance of push & pull - it was thrilling. The kisses were good. I also felt that they were emotionally connected. 2. Revenge - Satisfying! I liked how FL executed her revenge against the cheating husband. Then another revenge on behalf of her mother.3. Acting - Great performances by the cast. There was visually and acting chemistry between Yu Long and Sheng Yi Jie. They looked like a mature, power couple.4. Plot - It was refreshing! This drama was set in the world of art / painting. How FL, SML & ML were invovled in that industry. 5. FL characterisation - I liked seeing her at work because it's something I don't know much about. 6. Styling - I loved the emerald green qipao. The scene was brilliant! I basically loved anything worn by Sheng Yi Jie.7. Duration - I loved that this drama's running time was under 2 hours. It was well-paced.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's husband the SML was an asshole for betraying FL 2 ways (love & career). ML's wife and grandfather were atrocious. ML's father was another vicious person.Favourite sceneWhen FL let her hair down & kissed ML Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Bom drama de vigança Gostei desse drama vertical, porque é bem focado na vingança da FL para com o marido e a amante. Apesar da 2FL e o 2ML aparecerem, eles não são aqueles insuportáveis que fica "Ge Ge Ge" sem parar kkkkkkkAchei a história bem desenvolvida e as atuações boas, e os beijos não eram falsos, porque quando um dos atores namora/ é noivo/casado geralmente são aqueles jogos de câmera ridículos! E confesso que geralmente não assisto dramas com o ator Yu Long porque sempre é com a noiva dele, e acho extremamente cansativo eles contracenarem juntos em todo santo drama kkkkk Assim como fujo dos dramas com Zhu Yi Wei & Bai Xin Yi. Mas no geral o drama é bem bom, gostei da inteligência da FL e dei risada com a cena do leilão quando o ML diz: hoje eu percebi que eu sou rico. É tão bom kkkkkkkkkSó não entendi o porque do pulo na linha do tempo, já que eles já haviam ficado juntos e ela acreditou nele, para depois se reencontrarem na galeria... reviews.author: Candys
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 10 Rewatch Value 10 brotherhood in the middle of chaos for a short drama, this series is truly amazing. this is actually my first time watching a chinese drama with a zombie theme, and i was genuinely impressed by how well the story was executed. the plot flows smoothly and keeps you engaged from beginning to end, making it very easy to follow despite the short duration.the characters are extremely well written and memorable. each role feels strong and distinctive, and the actors did an excellent job portraying their characters, making them feel very real and alive on screen. their performances added depth to the story and made the emotional moments even more impactful. the presence of plot twists genuinely surprised me and kept the story exciting. even though the drama is short, it never feels rushed or incomplete. instead, it delivers a clear storyline that is both concise and satisfying. this makes it perfect for viewers who enjoy light dramas but still want something thrilling and engaging. i would highly recommend this drama to anyone looking for a short yet powerful watch. one of the most touching aspects for me was the bond between dong qing and lobak. their brotherhood was deeply moving, as they consistently protected and cared for each other, which added a strong emotional core to the story Read More Was this review helpful to you?

I had watched dramas by both Yu Xiao Wan and Chen Yun Ting.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She designs jewellery and I enjoyed her "at work" scenes. She is a great boss and a rational person. I liked that FL doesn't get mad when she found out about ML's real identity. She weighs pros and cons of being in a romantic relationship with ML. Great acting by Yu Xiao Wan.2. Romance - Lusty, loving & mature. I loved ML's dedication towards loving & protecting ML. FL was committed to the relationship once she felt sure & secure - I liked this!3. ML characterisation - He was smart to offer himself as muse. Though I am not a fan of secret identity, ML didn't drag it out.4. Styling - Loved FL's outfits as they exude confidence & elegance.5. Supporting characters - I liked FL's bestie & ML's cousin a lot!What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Feifei was too annoying. synopsis: In order to save her benefactor Jiang Xuan and Jiang Shu Cheng, Qiao Yue Sheng agreed to take care of Shen Huai Chuan and his son for six years with a mysterious old man. During the six years, she endured the indifference of the Shen family and the frame-up of Song Qian, silently waiting for the end of the agreement. After Song Qian returned, Shen Huai Chuan was partial to her and Shen Jing also betrayed her. Qiao Yue Sheng was disheartened and left resolutely after the six-year contract expired, and reunited with Jiang Xuan who had awakened. Shen Huai Chuan realized her importance only after losing her, but it was too late. When the truth was revealed, Shen Huai Chuan was seriously injured and dying to protect Qiao Yue Sheng. She finally chose to join hands with Jiang Xuan and start a new life. (Source: Chinese = Weibo || Translation = Google Translate) English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers FL with temporary amnesia with hot & imposing guy pursuing her This is my first drama starring both Qian Zhe and Wang Yi Yang. I think I chose this drama because it features a main character with amnesia. Overall I liked this drama.What I liked:1. Opening scene - Such a sexy & memorable scene! I first watched this drama not too long after its release and now with 4 months gone by and plentiful of vertical dramas watched, I can still recall the scene. 2. FL characterisation - I liked that she was a journallist and had to conduct an interview with ML.3. Romance - This is one of the rare dramas in which we see FL being pursued by 2 men. She even got to kiss both of them.4. Abs - Qian Zhe is one of the few vertical drama actors that have well-defined six / eight packs. His shirtless scene was a delight!5. Dumpling making scene - It was short but meaningful.What I disliked:1. ML's characterisation - At the start, I found him imposing because of his aggressive approach towards FL. However he redeemed himself when he showed genuine care towards FL's health.2. Antagonist - Lu Ze was an opportunist and manipulative. Favourite sceneOpening scene Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Enquanto que no Hidden Treasures, Yao Guan Yu interpreta um ML com atitude autoritária/sexual, o Qian Zhe, ao meu ver, interpreta mais de maneira fria e bruta. Já assisti mais uma ou duas versões deste plot, mas que não encontro as páginas aqui no MDL para citar corretamente seus nomes, mas adicionei 1 ao comentário da ASTER na página de Hidden. Por alguma razão enquanto eu maratonava esse plot, esse eu acabei abandonando aos 45 minutos, talvez tenha sido o último que assisti antes de dormir e depois simplesmente esqueci de continuar e fui para os próximos kkkkkÉ um plot até que ok, no começo o ML é bem bruto nas suas ações com a FL, mas com o passar do tempo ele vai melhorando, mas como ele sabia desde o início que a FL havia o esquecido, poderia ter falado ou agido de maneira diferente em algumas situações, não precisaria ser da forma que foi.Os beijos são ok, o último acho bem bonito. Só acho meio bleh quando entra a chá verde Bai Wei nos 45 do segundo tempo querendo encher o saco, mas faz parte...Eu gosto dessa versão da tatuagem da FL, é muitooooo bonita! reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Letdown by doormat FL and lack of communication between the couple I am a huge fan of Xie Yu Wang and have watched his older drama with Lu Lu Lu a few weeks ago. I was pumped when I heard about this drama because it's the second time Xie Yu Wang has paired with Lu Lu Lu. I was left disappointed by the time this drama ended.What I liked:1. Kisses - I loved XYW's kissing scenes. When permitted, he always expresses desire & passion in his kissing scenes, including those in this drama.2. Twin trope - I liked how this story was done even thought the overall vibe was negative. There was a refreshing twist to the twin trope.3. Styling - I liked XYW's clothes. The most stylish outfits I had seen on him.4. Supporting characters - I liked FL's bestie because she was rational and most of the time, smarter than FL. I also liked FL's daughter.5. Dynamics - I enjoyed watching interactions between ML and FL's daughter. What I disliked:1. Antagonists - ML's mother was annoying & evil. She favoured her eldest son over younger son. She disliked her daughter-in-law that led to disliking and punishing her granddaughter. I also disliked FL's family because they were parasites. Only concerned about wealth. The green tea character was pathetic.2. Romance - They had sex but were distant & hardly communicated. FL kept on insisting on divorce due to pressure from her in laws. She was stupid.3. FL characterisation - She was doormat - no wonder she was easy to be bullied. She married Si Ye out of guilt / pressure but never sought partnership from the marriage. reviews.author: Andreea-LygiaPopescu
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers One of the good ones, but... Perhaps it is time for the writers to understand that these stories need to feature better-developed characters, or at least allow them to grow throughout the show. I was rather pleasantly surprised by the drama; despite some overused tropes, it unravelled nicely and with some logic, until the last two episodes. Which felt rushed and too superficially thought. What I liked:1. First, I need to praise Wang Xie; he is expressive and knows how to act. His role was nicely built. The ML remained true to the FL throughout the entire drama, until the last moment and did whatever in his power to help her. I loved the way his role was constructed: never gave in to his mother, despised the deluded psychopathic wife wannabe and stood up for her, even if when her actions had no sense.2. I liked the story also; it had fluency (with some hiccups). There was no rape, no extreme abuse and even the one that existed was not dragged on forever and was dealt with properly.3. The friend of the FL seemed to be the "voice of reason" and much smarter than the FL. Who was a surgeon, but acted like an uneducated twit. 4. Even the evil mother was played very well. A petty woman with no soul who actually learns, the hard way, that everything in life has a price. Especially when you neglect your own child. What I didn't like:1. The obsession with the brother. I do understand that you suffer that your husband is dead, but you have a man alive and who venerates even the shadow you cast, and you hang on to something that is already gone, without even trying to give him a chance.2. Are all surgeons so weak and borderline stupid? First, she takes abuse from her family (well, let's say that there is an ounce of understanding I can offer, as we can't choose who our parents and family are), then she lets herself be repeatedly humiliated and stepped on by a revengeful b***h of a mother-in-law who needed to find a scapegoat for an accident. WHY? Because you feel guilty and you need to self punish yourself? Then, at least, do not drag your child into it. 3. So, he gets deprived of raising his own kid, and then, when she finds out that he is her father, had a breakdown and she leaves him, together with the second child. Depriving him of some other three years of his children's lives. Then she just decides one day... well, it seems that I love him, I will go back. A weak woman who would have never been capable of becoming a surgeon. Doctors who do that kind of work have to be very strong mentally, especially women, who have to overcome a lot of obstacles until they get into their position. For me, it sounded like the writers gave her a fancy job, just for the sake of showing that women can have such a career and be weak and easy to hurt at the same time. A strange idea about women I often see in East-Asian movies. 4. the villain. I do understand the delusion and the fact that she was a psychopath. I didn't understand the power she had over that nurse. Was that one so stupid not to go and, at least, let him know about what she made her do? He had enough power to protect her mother against whatever was threatening her. Arresting her was the most unsatisfactory ending for this woman. The drama as a whole was good, but the last two episodes had NO LOGIC. Maybe if they had tried a bit harder...PS. Let the poor guys kiss properly, for God's sake. And maybe it is time to stop with the big eyes full of shock when someone who obviously has the hots for you starts kissing. No one does that in real life, especially those who have been through a marriage and have a child also ... Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Eu gosto do plot de irmão gêmeo, mas confesso que este foi cansativo, é tanta reviravolta - por mais que seja previsível algumas coisas - e com tanta toxicidade por parte da mãe do ML e da família da FL que é revoltante.A FL, uma grande cirurgiã, por pseudo-culpa é uma frouxa e aceita todas as humilhações que a mãe do ML faz, e ele que diz tanto amá-la, simplesmente virou as costas por 5 anos para fugir de um possível divórcio sem nem se preocupar com o bem-estar dela na casa da mãe dele?O final foi extremamente corrido e simplesmente abrupto, gostaria de vê-la chegando com os dois e não sozinha.Gosto de ambos os atores, mas não acho que o roteiro tão dramático tenha os ajudado. reviews.author: Shin
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.5 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 I was expecting something RAW The theme is good but not used properly .. the FL's sister faced bullying and due to the psychological shock she is in coma .. the FL wants revenge but cause these culprits come from influential families she can't get direct access to them so she thinks of the classic and most original plan in any asian drama ..that is 'seduce the guy'.. yes !!! You read it right and this ML is conveniently the most influential man in the capital so why not .. ? She goes to him in the most cringe 'save me from the pervert' roleplay and the next thing we see they were making love. It's not like I don't like bubblegum romance but I was expecting something raw from this story ..perhaps more psychological focus on bullying sequence and a slow burn romance, but The way they made the ML succumb to her was such a turn off..no build up .. no development of feeling ..nothing ..infact it was too flat from the FL's side ..in the entire she was literally just making him dance to her tunes. Talking about acting and appearance both leads are mediocre .. FL looked a bit too seasoned for the ML .. I like her figure though she got good curves .. mind you that's very rare in asian drama but the ML looked too young around her ..and the reason why even with all those intense kisses their pairing was not giving enough sparks IYKYK, maybe an actor with a more manly appearance would've been a better pick. Either way the drama didn't hit in the right way. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 4.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Where is the revenge?!! Plenty of kisses but no chemistry between the leads I am a big fan of Destined to Like You. A member of subreddit CShortDramas told me that this drama is another version of Destined to Like You. Since I enjoy Ma Shi Yao's acting, I decided to watch and hhhhm this pales in comparison to the other drama.What I liked:1. Kisses - Plenty of them and 95% was initiated by ML. He devoured her.2. Supporting characters - I liked ML's buddies because they provided different points of view when ML confided in them. I also liked the guy who is friends with her sister.3. Opening - That scene is memorable alright. My saved Youtube link is gone but I can still remember what happened in the first 5 minutes.4. Styling - I liked outfits worn by ML & FL. Ma Xin Yu looked normal sized and that's nice in comparison to stick thin, underweight actresses.What I disliked:1. Acting - Not good. Ma Xin Yu's acting was one-note. She seemed indifferent most of the time - her facial expressions were poor. There was lack of chemistry and synergy between her and Ma Shi Yao.2. Romance - There was no emotion / desire behind those kisses despite the high volume. They kissed on cue and romance was mostly one-sided.3. Revenge - This drama is supposed to be about FL seeking justice for her sister who was bullied by rich kids. However in this version, there was hardly any focus on the revenge. She was a scatterbrain. If I hadn't watched Destined to Like You, I wouldn't understand why she approached ML in the first place.Favourite sceneWhen ML complained to his friends about FL's remark to him Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.5 Story 3.5 Acting/Cast 4.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers No revenge, The sweetness turns bland. I watched this last year since i want to see another Ma Xin Yu works. I have no problem with Ma Shi Yao works but his drama is average for me. After watching this, feels bland to my taste. No chemistry, No sparks and there is plenty of kisses scene and the leads only do the task without looking the emotion. Not really good.This version focuses on the romantic relationship ML and FL with numerous kissing scenes and a decent level of emotional tension. The plot is relatively weak, with many story elements left undeveloped. The revenge plot isn't clear enough; FL's motives are insufficient, and her goals are unclear. Feels in this version FL was too lazy to do anything. Many details are only implied in dialogue and not shown on screen. FL's motivation for revenge isn't foreshadowed early on.Revenge scenes have been significantly reduced, so you supposed to watch as a sweet drama about the ML pursuing FL but if there is no chemistry it would be too bland. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 4.5 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers Chemistry was there but not the script Okay so he was obssesed with her because she was *not* obsessed with him. I think he was so intense with her because she was pushing him away and he was panicking. Someone once said "trust is the only currency in a relationship..." subconsciously he knew she was hiding something and he was scared he was going to lose her over it.While I dont appreciate the overuse/misuse of mental health disorders in chinese media they didnt butcher it entirely. That being said it would be nice if they put out more positive mental health aspects in shows. Also, the actors/actresses did a really good job consindering how lacking the script was. Ive seen other better written out versions but the actors didnt have half as much chemistry as these two. Hope to see them together in another drama! Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers ML in this drama looks more like supporting character I watched this today and it feels kind letdown in half of drama. I quite like Zeng Yitong styling while Jin Luying beauty was hidden since MUA and stylist in this drama has a bad day when they did her makeup and costume. Both leads are delivers their character well but the problem is about the lack of ML screentime and luckily FL was not too stupid like other version.This version seems has more change on ML's character has been changed. He didn't treat the FL badly in her previous life; she just misunderstood him. ML doesn't pursue F too much; FL marries him even in second life. The latter half mainly focuses on the power struggle between the two princes. Unfortunately, the screenwriter's skills are limited, and the last 30 episodes are very drawn out, with various melodramatic plots pieced together. The drugging scene is repeated three times, and the villain's ineffective attempts to appear are very clichéd palace intrigue tropes, making it very dull.ML is more of a supporting character, while the SFL is a constant presence throughout the entire series, with more screen time than the ML. She appears in almost every episode, which is both annoying and noisy.Still decent watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.5 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 5.5 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers Nice premise wrong execution While the premise is quite novel, the story wasn't well-told. SML and SFL transmigrated into the book to drive the plot, and their perspectives were clearly those of the viewers – just like us. However, the limited runtime meant that developing the main characters' story while also introducing the second leads felt rushed, leaving neither aspect fully explained. Compared to the cast, the plot was weak, focusing primarily on the conflict between the main characters and their stepmother, with very little development of the main couple's romance. There was almost no emotional build-up or sweet moments, somewhat wasting Liu Qing and Bai Yan's acting talent. Secondary couple felt more like spectators, failing to even advance the plot; the main characters had to rely on their intelligence to resolve the crisis. The actress playing the stepmother overacted;her exaggerated facial expressions always made me sigh. Don't watch unless you want to see Liu Qing and Bai Yan romantic moment. synopsis: Rong Yu was out with her son when she was struck by a car and died. When she opens her eyes again, seventy years later, her son is now an old man and she has become the recently returned eldest daughter of the Rong family. Having died prematurely in the last life, Rong Yu takes advantage of her newfound access to proper education and studies dutifully. When her son falls ill, Rong Yu persists in convincing her eldest great-grandson to allow her to care for the old man. Slowly, she integrates herself into the Ji family once again. When her now-elderly son recovers, Rong Yu retakes her position as the pillar of the Ji family, educating and disciplining her two frustrating great-grandchildren. She's going to shape up the whole family! (Source: MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Zi Xian Sun Dou Gui Xia, Wo Shi Ni Men Tai Nai Nai" (孝子贤孙都跪下，我是你们太奶奶) by Wu Ying Xia (乌英夏). reviews.author: Shin
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 5.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 1.5 Rewatch Value 1.5 If Madness were a method of revenge.. Previously I thought There’s seriously something off with the FL’s brain— Every single time she needs to hide, she manages to make noise and get caught. no understanding of the concept of stealth whatsoever .. I was like "oh God !! Another lame female lead in another defeated drama", and started questioning my choice of picking this drama.But soon she leveled up her game quite nicely and she didn't just avenge her mother and brother's death ..she literally destroy the culprit's entire clan. Her way and shear will power of going to any extent be it hurting herself in the process or staying with her abusive husband, was commendable.. she could've just stayed with the ML who was powerful enough to help her accomplish her mission within a click of his fingers, but she walked this path of vengeance alone, not dragging any person on her route to pure destruction. I won’t share any more spoilers about the plot, but I’ll say this — we need more female leads like her. Not just in revenge stories, but in everyday narratives too. Characters who send a strong, clear message: women are more than capable of walking their own path, taking action, and owning the consequences. They don’t always need a male lead to come to their rescue — because strength, resilience, and independence can shine just as powerfully on their own.Jiu Lin was definitely a solid choice for the male lead, but I have to admit—I found the villain husband even more compelling in his own twisted Fifty Shades of Grey way. Characters like his aren’t easy to pull and gravitate an ample amount of hate, irrespective of that Liu Yaoyuan handled that balance brilliantly. And his lunatic side .. chef's kiss plus later the tussle between FL and this villian to see who can be the bigger lunatic, wow!Zhu Jin was wonderful as the female lead—her performance hit all the right notes. That said, I personally feel Daisy Li might’ve been an even better fit for this role. For one, the character demanded a more seasoned actress than the male lead to convincingly portray the age gap. And secondly, Daisy and Jiu Lin haven’t been paired before, which could’ve brought a fresh, dynamic chemistry. Her elegance and grace alongside his rugged charm might have elevated the impact.Still, the current casting isn’t bad by any means—it holds its own well.The ending was quite confusing and disappointing but that is pretty much expected from these pre independence plots, they have to accomodate that patriot sacrifice thing in the story so they just put the heroic death of ML in the end.
