reviews.author: Rissa_Mac
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 3.5 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers A crap shoot and a half I don’t usually write reviews for shows this terrible, but this one is almost laughable. For all intents and purposes, I dropped it half way through but skimmed through to see what happened… This show is everything wrong with minidramas. I was literally laughing out loud at how inane the plot is. Pseudo-sibling romance where half the time he actually does think their siblings? Check. Another actual sister who is actually in love with him incestuously? Check. Oh wait they’re not siblings either? Check? I honestly can’t figure it out. Memory loss? Check. Absolutely psycho second FL? Check. Evil mother who somehow gets forgiven? Check. Abuse, self harm, rape? Check. It’s like we take terrible tropes and put them in a blender…. OH AND THE FL DIES AT THE END IM SORRY WHAT THE ACTUAL HECK IS THIS STORY AND THEN WE GET A PARALLEL UNIVERSE FOR TEN MINUTES THIS IS INSANE. I don’t know if I’ve ever watched a drama this level of crap—which sucks because the first few episodes were awesome. Then it all went spiraling down the toilet. Goodness, someone fire the writers. reviews.author: Lynnea
reviews.review_text: Overall 2.0 Story 2.0 Acting/Cast 4.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 Drama scadente, appartenente a quella categoria di bassa qualità da saltare a piedi pari... Solitamente mi tengo ben alla larga da questo genere di drama, un sottogruppo che definire di categoria C significa essere davvero generosi. Più diffuse di quanto purtroppo dovrebbero essere, questo tipo di serie si mescolano a volte a quelle che normalmente meritano, per cui può capitare di incapparci per sbaglio. In passato mi succedeva piuttosto spesso, col tempo ho sviluppato forse la capacità di riconoscerli in tempo e girare saggiamente al largo.In questi casi c'è davvero poco o niente da recensire, non c'è qualcosa che è andato storto o dei difetti da sottolineare: a monte manca proprio la possibilità di ottenere un risultato decente. La qualità, su tutti i fronti, è a dir poco scadente. Eppure di drama così in giro ce ne sono, e anche molti: che seguito possano avere resta per me un vero mistero. Sono accozzaglie insensate di momenti scollegati, mal gestiti, senza coerenza e totalmente privi di logica... Sceneggiature amatoriali di chi per assurdo pretende di essere un professionista del settore ma che si risolvono puntualmente in situazioni morbose, protagonisti dalle camicie puntualmente sbottonate, discorsi insensati e bruschi tagli tra una scena e l'altra, quasi peggio di una sequenza di spot pubblicitari.La cosa che più mi spiace è che molte di queste serie - perlopiù romance - sono ambientate nell'era repubblicana cinese, periodo storico che trovo sempre interessante ma presente in pochissimi drama - di quelli degni di essere chiamati tali - quale ad esempio "Fall in love" (2021). Detto questo, la ciofeca per l'anno in corso l'ho vista (metto la spunta virutale). Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: DANIELAPOZO
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 5.5 Acting/Cast 3.5 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 1.5 This review may contain spoilers No sé , no me convence del todo. A ver , por donde empezar , soy fan a los mini dramas de 15 minutos , son faciles y rapidos , y realmente no busco gran historia ni escritura en ellos. Pero al menos que sean consistentes , lo primero que me molestó de este drama , el prota no besa bien , los , aunque en parte los besos se deben a cómo los quiera el director , pero hay actores que se entregan besando , como Yan Zi Xian . Bueno a la prota la he visto en otros dramas y es buena actriz y hermosa no tengo nada en contra de su personaje . 2 cosa que me dio vergüenza fue la escena del globo aerostático , osea si no tienen presupuesto suficiente hagan la escena en medio del bosque arriba una piedra , pero no me pongan una escena tan mediocre con los efectos y pantalla verdes más horribles , no se sintió para nada creíble esa parte , tampoco fue necesaria 😐🙄😶😒ya que el prota si quería acorralar a la chica lo hubiera hecho hasta en un barco en medio del mar , no sé , en un lugar real , y no una asquerosa pantalla verde😡😠🤮 , entiendo que usan mucho eso pero aquí no me gustó nada. 3 cosa , ya en cap el 12 empezó a perderse la trama , no se sabe bien a qué rumbo iba , y sí después me di cuenta en el 13 , a lo típico la separación porque creen que son hermanos🤨🙄 😐 , pero no contentos con eso después el protagonista pierde la memoria 😒😒y cree todo lo que le dicen😐 , ya saben como es eso si están familiarizados con los dramas republicanos , OLVÍDENSE DE UN FINAL FELIZ Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: Li Zhi Ning transmigrates into the real daughter of a wealthy family, who was tortured and murdered. Her mother and brothers can eavesdrop on her innermost thoughts! Is the fake daughter, Li Meng, an illegitimate child? Her mother, Lin Jing Yan, becomes a fierce protector. Li Chen, the second brother, immediately cuts ties with his best friend upon discovering he's an undercover agent. Master Fu Jiu fiercely defends his wife after hearing he'll "die a violent death." Initially intent on playing it safe, she's forced into a powerful family feud, where she uses a "heart hack" to awaken her family while ranting. Ultimately, the fake daughter's reputation is ruined, her scumbag father is imprisoned, but she defies fate and wins Master Fu Jiu's heart. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers I enjoy this drama I watched this last year and finally Chen Gang gets a proper good drama with good chemistry. I was repeated this drama since it was quite simple more than the synopsis.The whole cast has excellent acting skills, good looks and intelligence. The romance between Qin Tianai and Chen Gang is sweet and they have an interesting sparks. Before the amnesia, FL pursued ML. After the amnesia, ML pursued the FL. The revenge plot is intricate and step by step. The villain is intelligent and non-traditional one so it was quite good. The dual-strength setup is amazing, and the final gunfight scene is the coolest I've ever seen in a short drama.ML's younger brother was the unfortunate people. He was caught up in the feud between the ML and their father. ML probably only saw the younger brother as the child of the couple who forced his mother to commit suicide. ML's younger brother just wanted to be with the ML, but was always getting pushed away by ML and every action that he did was quite understandable.The plot is fast-paced, with not a single unnecessary episode. FL is incredibly intelligent; unlike some dramas where things seem obvious, she investigates immediately upon noticing something suspicious and quickly uncovers the truth. There are some heart-wrenching moments, but because they are presented in reverse chronological order, they are completely acceptable. The kissing scenes are natural and well-filmed.Recommended to watch some action drama. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: SooReneccs
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 A tale of not doing certain things to live a happier life. Drama focuses on 3 characters, ML FL ,2 ML whose decisions affect everything. Themes were; consider consequences before making decisions and know your own strengths and limitations.. The first applied more to the 2ML who killed the FL family whose family own a bank as he was manipulated by his uncle, the mastermind. 2ML was henchman of ML, his twin elder brother, the head of the family and warlord of the army. He was given conditional love by his father to always help his elder brother and thereby arouse d sibling jealousy and love-hate relationship. Hence he was easily manipulated by uncle for he was poor at making decision .So he killed her family even though. he was attracted but on denial mode since childhood when she took pity on him during a visit to his home when she found him isolated and kept hidden from attending party at his own home . She gave him a party cake to cheer him up. His love story with her was going into sadness as he can't wash off his guilt. He has a damaged personality due to conditional love of father and brother only to found out too late when his brother sacrificed his life for him that his brother really cared and loved him. He grew up after that to ,become the substitute groom .He loved her not to cause any more pain for her when he left her alone at wedding night and when he took a wedding photo without her. He then went off to war and perhaps as his uncle had said girls like heroes , played a hero too far and got killed.This drama is not for people who want a strong FL.who can kill the culprit in cold blood in revenge. When her family were killed she went to live with her father's close friend whose son was engaged to her dead elder sister. The matriarch of the family gave her protection on condition she entered as a dead sister substitute bride. FL was already attracted to ML since young when her sister was alive but kept it hidden while ML was really in love with her instead of her sister. Their love relationship was somewhat like forbidden love ,for in essence she was marrying her dead sister's love. hence happiness in such a marriage will have on and off guilt.Know one 's own strengths and limitations for FL did figured out that the killer was 2ML and his uncle the mastermind yet she didn't killed them instead 2ML killed his uncle and 2ML died in war. Grandmother was the most logical and practical realist for she had told her to forget about revenge and just married into her family. She also had the quiet strength to let go of her beloved dead elder grandson when she cried and begged forgiveness in a dream ,for burying him in unmarked grave and making his bride married his brother. She will made up for that in the next life. Later she was shown having a happy life and playing happily with grandson. She is a study of letting go. In contrast, FL also dreamed of dead ML coming back to tell her he was going to war. She begged him not to go but he was adamant and told her to grow up. She can't let go. She was in grief and depressed ,looking at wedding photos herself and ML and again with sadness when she received news that 2ML was killed and looked at his wedding photo, the one without her in it. She was not shown playing with her son instead only shown when son was around 10 years when she was at bedside of dead grandmother .Story ended with her closing the house and taking her son back to her old home to meet with his father and uncle. She is going to live in her world of illusion of happy memories. Pragmatic grandmother was straight- thinking as the truth lock her away from having a 2nd chance of happiness with 2ML. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Goofy af ... LOVE IT I legit almost died laughing. At first, it felt like your typical cliché setup, but the second she busted out that snake-walking move? Game over. Everything became 10x funnier the moment she started serving us secondhand embarrassment like a full-on Chuunibyou, and the way the ML just stares at her with pure pity.As a short, dumb drama, I absolutely loved it. Yeah, the CGI is trash, and the subs are soo shitty shity make no sense, but hear me out the FL and ML are too compatible. Also, I still can't wrap my head around their 10-year age gap. Like, what kind of 32-step skincare routine is she on? Insane. No one else could’ve played a snake demon like her, she’s got the moves of an elastic man. And don’t even get me started on that bald-cap Buddhist with the triple-sized head, or her as a egg cracked me up. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Zany FL made this fantasy drama enjoyable to watch I am preparing a reddit post on vertical drama actresses aged 35 and above and MDL & reddit friend thehepburn informed me of Shu Chang and this drama. Gosh I realised that I had this drama in my watchlist many many months ago (must be during my Zuo Ming phase). I watched it yesterday and was entertained.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - I agree with the other reviewer about this drama being goofy. Well thanks to Xiao Qing. I also liked that she was nice & genuine especially towards those who treated her kindly e.g. ML's grandmother & parents.2. Acting - Shu Chang excelled in this role. She commanded my attention whenever she appeared on screen. Zuo Ming performed well for a confused ML who later fell in love with FL. Despite the big age difference between them, their chemistry was dazzling.3. Romance - It was warm & touching which I didn't expect considering how impersonal they were during their first intimate encounter. There were some nice kisses & sweet gestures. That wedding scene was touching.4. Tone - I enjoyed the comedy bits. Hahaha the way FL walked before meeting ML's grandmother was damn funny. Drama was well-paced too.5. Duration - This drama clocks in at 2 hours 5 minutes which was good for me as I don't enjoy draggy dramas.6. Fantasy - I enjoyed the fantasy elements from the snake alter ego to her use of powers. There was reincarnation arc used in this drama too although I wish it was longer because I'd like to see more of their dynamics in the past.7. ML characterisation - Mr Nice Guy. I enjoyed his scenes which he remembered his past life.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Money hungry uncle & daughter who wanted something they did not deserve. Gosh the daughter was so desperate that she would stage scenes.2. ML's action - I was dismayed when ML didn't immediately back up FL when she was slandered by others. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Workplace romance that started with a blind date. Great chemistry! I write a column on reddit comparing 2 short dramas adapted from the same source. I was familiar with both main actor and main actress and since this version came out first, I watched this last weekend. I had mixed feelings about this drama but overall enjoyed it.What I liked:1. Romance - I must say I enjoyed watching their dynamics from boss-employee to fake couple and eventually true lovers. Their romance generated warmth. FL was shy but ML being affectionate is my favourite kind of ML. There was good amount of sweet and spicy scenes.2. Acting - Both Mao Sheng Er aka Qu Xiao Xiao and Ye Yi Chen did well in their roles. Both characters came off as endearing. I consider chemistry as a subset of acting and I was sold by their characters' love story because of their good chemistry. 3. FL characterisation - She was timid and easily intimidated but I liked her. She wasn't cloying and too cutesy.4. ML characterisation - I liked him the most after they cleared the misunderstanding.5. Supporting characters - I really liked ML's father - he was very supportive of their relationship. I also liked ML's best friend - that trick at the club was amusing. I also liked FL's close colleague for being protective of FL.6. Relationship reveal - Their private romance was dragged into the spotlight after a jealous colleague began spreading rumours about her. I liked how the relationship was revealed to their colleagues.What I disliked:1. Length - At almost 3 hours, I thought this drama was 30 minutes too long. The pacing was slow at the start of their awkward fake relationship but once a certain milestone was reached, the drama didn't feel draggy much.2. Antagonist - I think there was a woman who tried to stake claim over ML but ML was firm with boundaries.Favourite sceneWhen ML offered a piggyback ride to FL Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Familiar plot but both leads had rock vibe & gorgeous styling I found out about this drama on reddit and it is an adaptation of "I had one-night stand with younger man overseas then we met again in China 3 years later" plot. I have watched 4 other versions in total - Zhang Yun Tao, Shao Wei & Cai Cheng Yuan as MLs. I enjoyed this version.What I liked:1. ML characterisation - He got the bad boy vibe going and was the most aggressive / tough Lu Chi Ye out of 4 versions I watched. I liked that he threatened legal action to the company who dropped FL as their spokesperson. I also liked that he felt FL's pain when she confided her secret.2. Styling - I loved Qin Tin Ai's hairstyle and outfits for this drama. She had the rock chic vibe. The photo shoot with the motorcycle was different than the photo shoot in other versions 3. FL characterisation - She was tough as nails on the outside but had vulnerable moments too. 4. Romance - ML was aggressive with his bites & wooing style. There were nice kisses in this drama.5. Acting - It was my first time watching Qin Tin Ai & Liu Yi Long and I liked their acting in this drama. Qin Tin Ai is young to be Liu Yi Long's jiejie but somehow she made it work!What I disliked:1. Smoking - Not a fan of smoking. There was too much smoking shots in this drama.2. Acting - The acting of supporting cast (FL's agent, FL's family, the scumbag who had affair with FL's sister) was underwhelming. I felt the actress who played FL's agent was timid - she looked more like an assistant when she was supposed to be firm, no-nonsense.3. FL's grandmother - Unlike other versions, this version only had grandmother "appeared" during phone calls. The younger brother, Shen Jin, was despised by the family since childhood; while the elder brother, Shen Yu, noble and refined, fell into a coma due to an accident. reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers Interesting story using twin trope but bland FL & lacklustre romance let me down There is something about Ma Shi Yao that compels me to watch his dramas and update his MDL profile. I have always been intrigued by twin trope so I watched this drama. I didn't like it.What I liked:1. Twin trope - I liked how the trope was utilised in this story. It's not good vs evil twin like in most stories. Both made bad decisions.2. Styling - I liked ML's outfits. Well lack of proper tops for Ma Shi Yao was good for me.3. Opening scene - It was thrilling.4. Supporting character - I liked ML's assistant who happened to be woman. 5. Ma Shi Yao - I liked both characters that he played.What I disliked:1. Acting - There wasn't any chemistry between Ma Shi Yao and the main actress. Her acting was underwhelming.2. Romance - Lacklustre & underdeveloped. Scenes with supposed sexual tension lacked intensity to me. 3. FL characterisation - Bland. I couldn't connect to her so I didn't care much once second twin came into the picture. synopsis: After secretly loving Fu Ling Sheng for ten years and being married to him under a contract for three years, Qiao Zhi Xu finally looks forward to watching a meteor shower together with him. However, Fu Ling Sheng leaves midway after receiving a call from his childhood friend Jian Nuo. Left alone at the stargazing camp, Qiao Zhi Xu is caught in an earthquake. In a moment when her life hangs in the balance, she sends Fu Ling Sheng a message asking for help, only for it to be misunderstood as jealousy and deception, when in fact, the misleading message was sent by Jian Nuo. reviews.author: Rhody401
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 2.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 Second Changes do exist. I really enjoyed the storyline of this drama, and both the ML and FL gave excellent performances. The emotions, misunderstandings, regret, and pain were portrayed very well. My biggest disappointment was that for a romance drama, it was seriously lacking in actual romance.Qiao Zhi Xu secretly loved Fu Ling Sheng for ten years and then spent three years married to him under a contract. After giving so much of herself, the earthquake becomes the breaking point. She is fighting for her life while the man she loves believes her desperate cry for help is simply jealousy and manipulation.What made it worse was Jian Nuo's interference and the misunderstanding surrounding the message. By the time Fu Ling Sheng begins understanding what really happened and what Zhi Xu endured, the emotional damage has already been done.I especially liked the FL's development. Surviving the earthquake and struggling with PTSD changes her. Instead of continuing to chase a man who repeatedly placed someone else before her, she finally decides that when their contract ends, so will their marriage.The ML and FL had the acting ability and chemistry to give us a beautiful romance, which is why I wanted **more romantic moments between them**. We received plenty of pain, regret, and misunderstanding, but not enough love to balance it.Great storyline and excellent acting—I just wish the writers had remembered to give the romance some room to breathe. ❤️💔 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers I liked leads' performances in this rich guy-poor girl romance drama I was really impressed with Aorigele's acting in 'After the Fake Play Became Real, He Lost His Love Forever'. So I went through his drama playlists and this title had many positive comments. I was surprised by how much I enjoyed it.What I liked:1. Acting - This is my first time watching Jin Yanna and I really enjoyed her performance. I also loved Aorigele's performance because he made the character soft-spoken.2. Relationship - It's a slow burn romance that started off with student-teacher and then progressed into employee-boss, baby momma & later love. They resolved their misunderstanding in the first 28 minutes. I liked that writer didn't force a love relationship just because she was pregnant. 3. FL characterisation - She was kind & self-reliant but not meek / a damsel. When she was bullied, she fought back. 4. ML characterisation - I liked him despite the forced intimacy. He was patient & rational & tried his best to understand FL's actions. 5. Supporting characters - I liked ML's grandma for talking sense to FL about her pregnancy and indirectly offered to be her family. I also liked ML's friend / cousin who always helped around and to some extent, FL's childhood friend. What I disliked:1. Forced intimacy - I'd say their first intimate encounter was rape. It sucked but ML apologised to FL. 2. Antagonist - This time antagonist was self-proclaimed future wife of ML. She was doctor but her actions and long raptor nails baffled me. FL's family was despicable. 3. Boundaries - I hated that ML allowed antagonist to stay at his family home.4. Bullying - There were some humiliating scenes that I found unfair to FL.Favourite sceneWhen they talked about their feelings after FL got out of a trap Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 A place in the heart of someone who truly loves you. ❤️ ⭐ **8.5/10***Ai Ru Dong Yan* begins with Jiang Ci trapped in a marriage that has already left her emotionally exhausted. She has been married for three years, yet her husband’s heart belongs to his “white moonlight.” No matter what Jiang Ci does, she can never truly become the woman he chooses.Eventually, she reaches her breaking point.On a snowy winter night, a heartbroken and drunken Jiang Ci unexpectedly meets the ML. One impulsive night between two strangers becomes the beginning of a relationship neither of them planned.What I enjoyed was watching Jiang Ci slowly move away from a marriage where she was constantly made to feel second best. Her relationship with the ML begins with physical attraction and plenty of complications, but gradually develops into something much deeper.The ML also surprised me. What begins as an unexpected encounter turns into genuine attachment, protectiveness, jealousy, and love. Their chemistry is strong because both characters clearly feel the attraction between them, even when neither wants to admit how emotionally involved they have become.Then Jiang Ci discovers she is pregnant, completely changing the situation again.For me, the pregnancy isn't what creates their relationship—it forces them to finally confront feelings that were already developing.I especially liked seeing Jiang Ci realize that she doesn't have to spend her life begging someone to choose her. After years of being pushed aside for another woman, she finally experiences what it feels like to have someone actually want **her**.Her first marriage taught her how lonely love can feel when it is one-sided.Her relationship with the ML teaches her something completely different: Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Tenho quase certeza que assisti as adaptações "Crimson Too Deep" e "Heart of Destruction", mas não marquei, assim como eu não havia marcado essa como assistida e me deparei online com um novo upload no youtube e dei play antes de dormir.Sei com certeza que assisti, porque estão marcadas, as versões Fei Se Qi Yue (ruim) e Beyond the Flame (mais ou menos). Eu gosto da presença que o ator Li Ke Le tem neste drama, mas não afirmo com certeza que ele fez um ML que daria tanto medo e respeito como se era esperado de seu personagem, já que ele era a figura mais importante da família. Não vemos esse poder todo por muito tempo no drama. Já a atriz Tang Jing, a vejo mais como personagens de época do que em dramas modernos, não sei se foi sua maquiagem e roupa neste drama que me deu essa sensação. Sua personagem oscilava entre uma postura mais direta e firme com a angustia, mas não consegui captar em sua atuação esses sentimentos são aflorados, nem quando ela distribuiu tapas.Na época em que assisti as versões eu não era tão fã da premissa da história, então me deixei levar pela história extremamente absurda que foi apresentada, mas hoje consigo analisar um pouco mais calmamente, apesar de continuar achando o 2ML um tremendo de um hipócrita nojento e a 2FL a clássica das chá verdes amantes nojenta. reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Intriguing opening scene but once cover was blown, drama became bland Ok I have to admit - I really really like Ji Jun Liang's visuals that I recently developed a habit of watching his new releases. As expected, I was disappointed by this drama.What I liked:1. Opening scene - The paparazzo scene at the start was exciting because it was something I had not seen in Chinese dramas.2. Styling - The disguise was awesome. The pink wig looked gorgeous on the main actress.3. Ji Jun Liang - Wow, he got to show us his body. His face card is top notch as expected.4. Kisses - Good kissing scenes thanks to JJL. His character always initiated it.What I disliked;1. Romance - Lacklustre. 2. FL characterisation - She was silly like always fumbling. She was also cowardly - always scared of someone. I couldn't believe the things she did to ML.3. Acting - The main actress was so inexperienced because her acting was very underwhelming. reviews.author: Rhody401
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 6.5 ML putted storyline off This was an interesting Chinese short drama with a mix of romance, misunderstandings, hidden identities, revenge, and a little bit of craziness thrown in.The story follows genius hacker Tang Xiao Wan, who is forced to marry Song Shi Yan, a cold and stern CEO, in place of her sister. What begins as a marriage neither seems completely happy with slowly turns into a complicated relationship filled with misunderstandings and feelings neither of them knows how to express.Three years into their marriage, a mysterious pregnancy test causes even more suspicion between them. Wanting a divorce, Xiao Wan secretly disguises herself as the hacker “Wang Gang” to threaten Song Shi Yan. But things become much more complicated when she discovers that her sister has returned with a new face and is carrying out her own revenge plot.I enjoyed the mystery surrounding the sister and watching the truth slowly come out. I also liked seeing Xiao Wan and Shi Yan finally begin to understand each other after so many misunderstandings.However, the ending felt incomplete to me. After everything the characters went through—the secrets, revenge, misunderstandings, and emotional pain—I expected more closure. It felt like the story reached the point where everything was finally coming together and then suddenly stopped.I would have loved a few more scenes showing Tang Xiao Wan and Song Shi Yan afterward, especially seeing what their relationship became once all the secrets were gone. Even a short epilogue would have made the ending much more satisfying.Overall, it was an entertaining drama with an interesting storyline, but the rushed and incomplete ending kept it from being as satisfying as it could have been. ❤️ Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Good showcase of mental health disorder but final 15 minutes was a haste! I enjoy Zhang Qi Xuan and Qiao Jia Le's dramas so I was delighted to find out that they have worked together. I was intrigued by the comments left on Youtube. Mental health issue is definitely not explored much in vertical drama space. That being said, I have mixed feelings about this drama.What I liked:1. Acting - Both Zhang Qi Xuan and Qiao Jia Le did well in their roles. I enjoyed their performances be it as their individual character or as a couple. They had good chemistry and I'd like to see them together in other dramas.2. Romance - Their romance was a slow burn, which was a good choice by the writer & director considering FL's delicate state of mind. There were some nice kisses and other physical touch. I wish FL would show more desire/appreciation instead of overthinking ML's moves.3. Mental health issue - It was done well but there was potential to go deeper with FL's lived experiences.4. Supporting characters - In spite of the bad treatment, I actually liked FL's sis during a major reveal at 1:30:00 mark. To my surprise, she displayed compassion towards FL whom did not appreciate it unfortunately. Anyway I liked ML's assistant and grandma.What I disliked:1. Child issue - This arc was so underwritten that it didn't add much value to this drama. It could be omitted from the overall drama.2. Third act - There were 3 major reveals in the last 15 minutes. Such lazy writing with this drama being 2 hours and 30 minutes long.3. Ending - WTH is the ending about? reviews.author: Li Mu Yan
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 Moments I Loved, and Moments I Questioned Okay, first of all—this plot? I’ve seen vertical short dramas on social media with the exact same energy. You know the type: a bit of mystery, a sprinkle of love, and a whole lot of “what is going on?” The acting? Let’s just say it’s not terrible… but I wouldn’t exactly call it award season either.Now, let’s talk about the demons—because I’m still trying to process that one flower demon (don’t ask me which flower, I forgot too). She can magically show up to the female lead, whisper life lessons or whatever, but somehow can't appear to the love of her life? Girl, teleport better.And episode 23? Whew. The FL, who apparently owns some magical cooking tools that can expose a demon faster than garlic in a vampire den, just… forgets to use them? Instead, she skips the logic, skips the tools, and goes straight to tears. Ma’am, be serious.Then she says the ML was terrible to her in the real world and broke her heart… only for him to pop up in the finale like, “Hey, do I know you?” The whiplash. The emotional gymnastics. I was spinning.But hey, if this drama made you feel something, even confusion or mild betrayal—that’s still something, right? No hate to the fans, truly. We all love our mess in different flavors. 💅 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Yumi
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 4.0 I saw a clip of this, on IG I believe and I was intrigued by the ML.I didn't know who he was back then, then I happened to watch another drama of his and I loved him there, didn't like the drama so much, it was ok-ish, so I thought I'd give him another chance and try this one, maybe I'll be a fan.This wasn't the best choice, to like this you have to be already a fan of the ML before starting, not the opposite. But aside from the story the performance was ok.The story is not coherent, made worse by the wrong subtitles, now my Chinese is terrible I know but in some parts I hear something and the subtitles says something else, that's how bad it was... Even a non-Chinese person can spot the differences.Now the end was weird and in some parts I didn't even know who is bad and who is good and the funny scenes at the end were odd too.The acting was nice, I didn't know what was going on and there were too many characters unnecessarily, romance was non existent, I know the ML did a lot for the FL but they didn't have any type of intimacy or romance happening between them, i didn't realise that till the last minute when it suddenly hit me that the two leads didn't even kiss lol they hugged once maybe xD and the genre is just romance!! Nothing else in the tags and that's the main thing the drama lacked of.I don't know if I like it or not, but I'm sure this isn't the best VD to watch if you want to enjoy the ML performance ~~ Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: lullabaey
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Good, not bad Wow, just wow. This drama is pretty good, surprisingly. I have no expectations initially but the first episode got me all hooked and binge-watching all the way until the last episode. Everything is great. The costume, acting, characters. Oh my god, the characters was chef’s kiss🤌💗, ESPECIALLY the villains. I love the emperor’s character so much even if he’s annoying. But the character development at the end was really nice. Now here’s the issues I have with the drama. First, no CGI powers. I mean, it’s not that bad I guess but it looks so weird and awkward. Second, the ending. I actually love the initial parts of the ending where the former empress came by the dungeon and told the reason why she did what she did. But then it took a 180 after she died to resurrect the evil demon. Huh? I was like whaaat? Why tho? That kinda ruined the ending for me. They could’ve done the ending with some fights or something like that with the main villain (the former empress) and ended it like that. But they really have to resurrect the evil demon. It was so unnecessary and lame. Third, the ending, again. If I understand correctly, the ML’s dad turns out to be the evil demon, right? I thought at the end where the evil demon is resurrected, he is going to have a dad-son moment with ML, which I think would be a very interesting plot scene. But no. I think they just forgot about that element tbh. Alright that’s it. It’s getting way too long now. Do watch this drama because it’s really not that bad. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Me poupe ne kkkkEnfim, a chá verde também é tão sem graça que não faz nem cocegas, só tem um burburinho na empresa dele que logo é resolvido.Enfim, perdi meu tempo. synopsis: Jiang Xian Yu, the youngest VP in investment banking, drives 80% of her boss’s success yet endures constant mistreatment. At home, her parents’ son's preference leaves her earnings wasted on a lazy brother while she struggles alone. Overworked and neglected, she dies at 33. Reborn eight years earlier, Jiang vows to live differently. Bound by a non-compete, she leaves her high-stress job to return to nannying—a simpler role she once did in college. Though early interviews falter as employers’ wives dismiss her for her youth and beauty, she eventually secures a two‑month contract with the wealthy Su couple, unaware they are the grandparents of Su Ling Yuan, the investment banker who once sought her out. This time, she is determined to prioritize herself. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Touching story about neighbours-turned-friends-turned lovers going on weight loss challenge I was apprehensive about this drama because it is about a fat girl. However I watched it because I am a fan of both Liu Xi Yu and Ma Shi Yao and the short running time. I watched it on youtube and I believe drama is less than 2 hours long. I enjoyed this drama!Trigger warning: Suicide attemptWhat I liked:1. Fat main character - A lot of the vertical dramas with a fat main character tend to use different actresses for "before" and "after" weight loss scenes. I believe the producer made a good call to get LXY & MSY to wear fat suits instead. What worked (for me) was the motivation and the journey of weight loss.2. Romance - This drama explores friends-to-lovers trope. I liked it because they went on a weight loss journey together, discovered each other's inner strength and fell in love.3. FL characterisation - She was very endearing. I liked her spirit and enthusiasm once she set a goal.4. ML characterisation - He fell hard for her. I was moved that he tried to earn as much as he could so he could support FL with her goal. I also liked that he was a nice guy - he intervened when FL had a tough time.5. Public opinion - In one of the scenes, there was a rumour that affected FL's reputation. I liked that crowd who gathered near FL & ML took their side instead of the rumourmonger's side.6. Vlog - I enjoyed these scenes. I also liked that the characters talked about income from sponsored ads / product placement.7. Acting - LXY & MSY did a great job in their roles. I was moved by their characters' actions and felt warm throughout the drama.What I disliked:1. Antagonist - His motives were unclear but I think he liked having one person who knew him and dote on him. He sabotaged FL's health challenge - he was selfish.2. Moments - I wish there was one more episode to show us moments of FL & ML doing lovey-dovey stuff as a couple. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers Esse drama é um misto de sentimentos tremendo, porque ao vermos a FL doente, para morrer, tendo que aturar o ex-marido fazendo tudo que fez para a 2FL foi doloroso.Assim que a FL morre e sua alma fica vagando, o ML revela toda a verdade. Eu abomino protagonistas que largam suas vidas e humilham as pessoas que dizem amar por culpa ou gratidão, mas ele viu seu erro e ai o drama começa a caminhar para outra direção. É até difícil descrever sem dar spoilers porque tudo influencia muito o que eu senti.O personagem de Wang Bo, apesar de tudo, para mim é um canalha, ele largou a esposa e não satisfeito ainda a desprezou repetidamente, e depois, cheguei até ter pena dele, porque ele - que sempre acreditou que após terminarem - ela estaria bem, viu que não era a realidade e que tudo na sua vida desmoronou. Mas sim, ele a traiu, ele foi beijado pela outra e terminou com a FL. A FL, por mais ferida que estivesse quando descobriu todas as mentiras e o motivo do término ainda desejou que ele vivesse bem, então não a acho ruim, ela sabia que morreria e não adiantava insistir neste amor. Ela foi a vítima de toda a situação, seja com sua família, sua saúde, seu casamento. Mas o confronto sobre o seu desejo e o que seria correto para si, me deixou mexida. A 2FL, eu nem a culpa extremamente, mas a odeio, ela revelou saber de tudo e insistir, mas gostei da sua finalização. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.5 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 4.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Horrible ML, doormat FL with lacklustre romance I watched this drama as part of my assignment on Cheng Cheng and his collection of dramas for subreddit CShortDramas. I have to admit that this is one of my least favourite Cheng Cheng dramas. What I liked:1. Visuals - Cheng Cheng was shirtless in two scenes if I am not mistaken. He played a bad boy, a very handsome one.2. Styling - I loved his styling for this drama. Cheng Cheng was smoking hot when wearing biker outfit. In fact he won the poll for best looking male lead in biker outfit on subreddit CShortDramas. I also loved FL's pink dress that she wore for this drama poster. 3. Shots - The scenes of them riding a motorbike were beautifully shot.4. Kisses - Hot, passionate kisses.What I disliked:1. ML characterisation - He was bloody rude & possessive. Never apologised to FL for his abhorrent behaviour.2. FL characterisation - She seemed like a doormat. I don't understand the appeal of being with someone who is rude and horrible to you. I think she is the type who believes she can change him. Girl needed to understand and value her own worth.3. Plot - Quite dull that I fell asleep and felt the story didn't progress much. No need to rewind.4. Romance - Albeit the passionate kisses, the romance element was lacklustre. I didn't buy their romance at all.Favourite sceneWhen ML & FL were riding on motorbike Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.5 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Eu gosto muito do Cheng Cheng, mas algumas atuações e dramas que ele faz são péssimos, e este é um deles. Seu figurino também era uma mistura de canalha CEO, com rebelde e na fase adolescente não se encaixava.Essa adaptação é terrível, e eu gosto MUITO da versão "Just Out of Reach". Aqui é tudo mais denso, ambíguo o relacionamento entre os pais, a história da mãe, o contexto como um todo ficou bem ruim.Não conhecia a Chen Shu Yi, ou simplesmente não a reconheci, mas definitivamente eu não gostei da sua personagem, apesar dela ter uma postura mais direta e provocativa aqui. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 9.5 Fluffy and sweet the two main leads pulled off the best version of "puppy love" I have seen in a chinese vertical drama. The story centers around a boy who falls in love with a girl during high school. Despite him being an elite and in an entirely different social and economic class he blows up a lab and gets kicked out of school so he can transfer to her school. He spends their junior year of high school being desk mates working up the courage to ask her out. Only to leave a letter in a book that she never saw. three years later he's about to list a company and she's still in university. He starts to actively pursue her while also discreetly helping her. honestly it's refreshing charming and sweet. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers Mellow jiejie romance that could have done better with more chemistry and less running time I am a fan of jiejie romance and I like Bai Yan's acting. The moment I saw this drama on its release day, I made a point to watch it immediately. It's great that older woman-younger man stories have grown to include different vibes from spicy, lusty & fast-paced to mellow & slow unravelling. This drama belongs to the mellow & slow unravelling. I liked it.What I liked:1. Editing - Good production value. This drama made me feel like I am watching traditional 45-min-per-episode Chinese drama.2. FL characterisation - She was focused on building her career. I understood why she didn't like her mother arranging blind date / marriage for her.3. ML characterisation - He was smitten by FL. I liked that he respected FL's decision.4. Romance - The meet cute was amusing. Slow & steady romance with resistance coming from FL (who resisted relationship in general, not ML). There were many sweet moments and some nice kisses.5. Supporting characters - ML's friends were entertaining. The mothers of the leads were adorable in their own ways.What I disliked:1. Duration - At almost 3 hours, I found this drama too long. The little misunderstandings were unnecessary.2. Acting - I didn't sense much chemistry between Bai Yan and Zeng Xi Tang. I also found Zeng Xi Tang's acting in this drama a tad underwhelming. He gave much memorable performances as SML in other dramas.Favourite sceneWhen FL finally admitted her feelings for ML Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Sweet romance between go getter FL and fox ML (he's a magical creature) I was drawn to this drama because the translated title implies fox husband. I enjoy fantasy dramas so I watched it. I liked this drama very much.What I liked:1. Fantasy - I loved the fox arc. The appearance of his tail and his powers were delight to watch, especially that opening scene.2. ML characterisation - I loved that he wanted to cook & do housekeeping. He was loyal, protective and loving towards FL. 3. FL characterisation - Smart & go-getter. I also liked that she was kind - that's what attracted ML.4. Romance - I liked how their relationship progressed. There was a good balance of sweet, tender and spicy moments.5. Supporting characters - I liked ML's secretary Fu.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Sister was incompetent, greedy with nasty personality. I couldn't believe she wouldn't mind harming her sister just to accomplish her goal. She had too much screentime. I also disliked FL's grandfather for his biased judgement. The fox princess was another annoying character.2. Hidden identity - I wish ML had come clean about his fox identity sooner. I also wished that they had formed partnership to bring down Rou Xue.Favourite sceneThe opening scene Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers My Favourite Wang Dao Tie-Zhao Jia collaboration I watched last year and so far this is my favorite Wang Daotie-Zhao Jia works so far. The chemistry is right and they chooses the theme of drama right.This script has a fresh and interesting premise. The first half is a light comedy, the middle is sweet romance, and the later part features some redemption. There are no clichéd plots. SFL is written out early on; her early antics mostly turn into assists, while the SML is the ultimate wingman for ML and FL.The emotional portrayal is delicate. FL's journey from initially deceiving purely for money and fearing exposure, to falling in love, to being unwilling to leave, to deep love, is portrayed very well. Applause to Zhao Jia.Whether the true or false heiress is included in the ending is irrelevant, because regardless of FL's identity, the ML has already accepted her, which adds to the ending's perfectionThe letdown is the dubbing since it's from Tinghuadao.Recommended to watch. reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 9.5 Burning Love, Unblemished(2025) is a nice romance miniseries with Li Zi Qian (as Zhou Li Cheng) and Zhang Shan (as Jiang Wanzhi) in the leading couple’s role. reviews.author: Shin
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 5.5 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 FL : Who Killed My Dad? Who Knows, Let’s Drag It Out! Another drama where nobody dares to tell the truth because—well!!! If they did, how else would they drag the story out for 20 episodes?The FL has dreams of her past (which, of course, she has conveniently forgotten) where she witnesses her father’s murder. Determined to uncover the truth, she embarks on an investigation, stumbles upon the ML, and… well, no further spoilers.The plot is weak and painfully unoriginal. ML had his own deep reasons for doing what he did, but instead of offering a logical explanation, he chose the noble path of silence—leading to endless misunderstandings, wasted time, unnecessary deaths, and for us, an extended storyline we never asked for.FL’s acting is, at best, average. I’ve seen her in other dramas, and my opinion remains unchanged—improvement is clearly not on her to-do list. ML, on the other hand, is a different story. His expressions of silent suffering? Absolute chef’s kiss. You can feel the heartbreak oozing from his soul.The main highlight of the drama? Even after losing her memories multiple times, FL somehow keeps falling for the same guy. Either it’s true love or a serious case of déjà vu.You could give it a try if you manage to find a version with decent subtitles—personally, I struggled a lot with that. But if you can’t, just skip it. You won’t be missing much. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Blkfln
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 6.5 Not Amazing, Not Bad Story & PacingThe plot blends fantasy with elements of suspense and is generally well-structured, aside from some slightly drawn-out parts (largely caused by one of the female lead’s questionable choices, discussed later) in the middle of the story. Since this is a short-form drama, the portrayal of events and emotional development tends to be simplified, but the opening is smooth and the overall pacing remains brisk. The ending avoids the sequel bait and instead provides a final plot twist and proper conclusion to the story, which is always appreciated.Visuals & MusicThe visuals are the drama’s strong point. The costumes and sets are lavish, and the CGI is clean and well-executed, giving the show a polished, high-budget look. Visually, it stands out among many short-form dramas. The OST is emotional and fits the mood well without overpowering the scenes.Cast & ActingThe lead couple has decent chemistry, and their relationship development is generally enjoyable. The ML delivers a solid, controlled and emotionally nuanced performance, especially in intense scenes. The FL, however, is where the drama struggles the most. Her performance often feels overly deliberate, with an energy level that doesn’t quite match the tone of the story. The exaggerated delivery and overdone “cute” acting come across as forced rather than natural. On top of that, her character repeatedly makes poor and questionable choices, which ends up giving the impression that the character lacks intelligence and makes it harder to connect with her emotionally.OverallThis drama is not a masterpiece, but it’s also not difficult or stressful to watch. Thanks to its strong visuals, good acting (except FL), brisk pacing, and a properly wrapped-up ending, it works well as a short-form drama you can watch smoothly from start to finish (12 mins x 20 eps). While it may not leave a strong lasting impression, it’s a decent, visually pleasing option for viewers looking for a light watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers A atuação da atriz foi um balde de água fria para o drama. Infelizmente as atuações me fizeram torcer muito o nariz assistindo a este drama, a atriz Li Meng Yu não foi bem em sua personagem, suas expressões eram medianas na maioria das vezes e nas cenas que deveria ter o maior impacto emocional da FL ela simplesmente não conseguiu transmitir nenhum sentimento coerente para tais.Já o Yang Yu Bin, confesso que me surpreendi com sua atuação mediana para um personagem tão excêntrico e controlador, tive que pausar e simplesmente ir atrás de outros dramas dele que eu já assisti para entender se ele sempre atuou tão exageradamente assim, mas não, houveram outros papéis em que sua atuação era decente. Não sei se então foi um problema com o personagem que era tão complexo.Eu gosto de dark romance, eu gosto de personagens masculinos e/ou femininos que fazem esse jogo de amor forçado, mas a base para que fique bom é a atuação e o roteiro coerente. Aqui o ML começou como um jogo de controle porque ele finalmente estava percebendo um interesse dele por alguma mulher, porque obviamente depois, lá no meio do drama - acredito eu, foi revelado que ele tinha a doença do toque e aversão a mulheres kkkk Mas toda a artimanha que ele fez já era a possessividade dele e o amor que ele não compreendia, mas diferentemente de outros MLs, não senti que ele merecia tal relacionamento. Já a FL, apesar da atuação bem ruim da atriz, era uma personagem um pouco mais coerente em suas ações. Ela já queria ficar com ele, apesar de saber que seu pai não aceitaria, mas descobrir que foi ele quem destruiu o seu castelo de areia fez com que ela não o quisesse mais porque sabia que aquilo não poderia ser um amor normal.A passagem de tempo foi bem mediana, a cara dela continuava a mesma, bem de sonsa, o único momento em que vimos uma expressão um pouco maior foi quando eles se reencontraram e houve a cena da cama, onde ela assume o controle de seduzi-lo, mas só, porque veio o banho de água fria com um beijo bem morno, principalmente para um casal que estava se reencontrando e com aquela paixão que era pra ser consumida pela saudade.Enfim, é isso, visto, mas esquecerei rapidamente. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers O drama é bem escrito, tem uma lógica que vai até o fim e é um pouco mais realista do que os demais dramas do mesmo tópico: traição/separação. A FL descobre que o marido (interpretado pelo Xu Kai Xin) a traiu e roubou itens da sua mãe e endividou a empresa. Ela que era reconhecida por compor músicas havia largado por causa do casamento há 6 anos.Ela sofre ao descobrir tudo, mas é ponderada, contacta um advogado e vê como recuperar as coisas legalmente e corre atrás disso. A FL entra em um programa de variedade de divórcio com o marido, que insistiu, e a 2FL, amante dele é a anfitriã do programa e o personagem do Ye Hao Ran é convidado. SPOILER AQUI...Ela não dependeu de nenhum homem para conseguir tudo de volta, o seu admirador só a apoiava em silêncio e poucas vezes teve que agir. Apesar de torcermos sempre para que o final seja feliz no sentido romântico, esse final foi muito satisfatório porque, ela não correu para outro relacionamento, ela sabe da importância que ele teve neste momento, de quanto ele gosta dela, mas foi perseguir seus sonhos que ficaram abandonados por causa do casamento e ela também pensou nele, porque em poucos anos ele conquistou muita coisa, então os 2 anos que ela ficaria fora, ele poderia pensar também. E as pétalas caindo no final com a frase dele mostra que ele a conhece bem e torce por ela.Zhang Chu Xuan foi muito bem neste papel. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Supernatural murder mystery with a touch of romance I was browsing through my iQiyi app when I found this drama. The synopsis intrigued me as it reminds me of Western supernatural series such as True Calling and Ghost Whisperer. So I clicked play and overall I liked this drama.What I liked:1. Supernatural theme - It's refreshing and I really enjoyed it.2. FL characterisation - She's aloof but smart. I really liked that she's always a step ahead of others. Zhao Fei was excellent in this role.3. ML characterisation - He's a workaholic but not overbearing. He's smart - I liked that he came out with a plan to convince shareholders.4. Romance - As expected, there is romance. A sweet one but the chemistry between Zhao Fei and Yang Cheng Han was lacking for a romantic couple. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Not too popular, but good. I watch this since I got free trial iQiyi and this drama was on the recommendation page and it was suspense romance which is rare for chinese short drama.FL is a mortician, and the ML is a body brought in for burial after a car accident. Through a series of coincidences, they develop a love story that transcends life and death, a classic bickering romance. Zhao Fei's hime-cut hairstyle is stunning, and her inherent mysterious aura perfectly suits the role. The scene where she controls the ML is incredibly cool. ML's initial soul form, controlled by the FL but invisible to others, is practically invincible. I quite like ML's mother isn't blindly trusting or hostile towards the FL. She initially suspects her, but gradually trusts her and takes good care of her. We need more mothers like this—positive characters with intelligence.ML claims to be corrupted by FL, but he's secretly thrilled. The confession was also unique; ML confessed with a mix of words and true feelings, yet the actors' performances were incredibly natural, especially Zhao Fei whose expressions and demeanor were perfectly captured. It is still unclear about FL family tragedy reason, i wish they give 3-5 episode for that.Still decent to watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 3.5 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 4.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Boring uncle romance drama with no chemistry between leads I missed Huang Bo and when this drama was released, I watched within first few days of release. Unfortunately this drama was not great. Boring uncle romance unlike the other drama Huang Bo co-starred with Zhi Peng.What I liked:1. Mafia boss - Not many scenes but they were fascinating. The gang was menacing.2. Language - Wonderful to hear Cantonese. Not sure why there was mix of languages because ideally I wanted to hear boss & underlings to speak the same language.3. Supporting characters - ML's henchman was entertaining. His jabs at ML were funny & he got away with saying his thoughts unfiltered.4. Styling - I didn't like Huang Bo's gelled up hair which reminded me of Spike from Buffy the Vampire Slayer. However his clothes were good especially the pleather jacket.What I disliked:1. Romance - I didn't buy it. Rong Rong didn't contribute to the relationship - she was lucky to be doted on.2. FL characterisation - She was boring, insecure & passive. A damsel with no personality. Too cute for my liking.3. Acting - The main actress gave a bland & amateurish performance. Plus there was no chemistry with Huang Bo.4. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 An "Okay" Season One Overall I'm found it slightly difficult to rate because on the overall show aspect I definitely enjoyed the series. But at the same time, one of the major factors of the show IS the case solving and I was absolutely and completely lost during this aspect. They would come up with evidence that just made me ask "did I miss something?" over and over again. So in that aspect it became a "just go with it" type show that I had to ignore. THIS I didn't care for. What I did like was the varied filters and lighting or scenes... the ACTUALLY shooting scenes in the dark when it's night... and the character camaraderie that grows between everyone. Fair warning, this wraps up fairly well "as is", but it IS a Season One drama. I liked it well enough that I will probably watch Season Two whenever it comes out. Overall Rating factors in the things I REALLY liked against how much I did not care for the case solving... :6.5/10 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 4.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 He Xian Sheng You Zai Hong Ta De Bai Yue Guang Le (2025) is a romance miniseries with Wang Zilin (as He Huai Zhou) and Wang Yujing (as Shen Si) in the leading couple's roles. The cast did a decent job bringing their characters to life and the leading couple had some cute moments but there was no strong romantic chemistry. The story had some good developments but the romance lacked luster and the end was not only rushed but also unexciting. Is the kind of drama where the viewer feels that something good is coming just to have the leading couple get closer romantically but nothing but a bit of sensuality and not even breathtaking embraces.In the meantime, you can watch the drama on YouTube:"After the scumbag cheated on her, she married his powerful uncle and was spoiled by him" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e3hXFU5QMug) or:"Breaking up with Him Is Blessing in Disguise】After being betrayed, she finally met her soulmate!" reviews.author: NickB
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers Fleeting From My Memory I think the male lead has it in his contract that he must play a characters that is stupid, but acts like he's smart. And he must show his abs at least once. And if you've seen even two of his other series, I'm guessing you can predict how this one ends. I will say that I enjoyed the FL knew how to fight... when it was convenient. But it's better than most of these shows where the woman can't fight her way out of a wet paper bag. The storyline is nothing new, you've seen it a thousand times. And that's fine, I'm guilty of enjoying these tropes. It had one jealous character desperate to get with the object of their obsession, which I enjoy. I will say that these Cdramas love having actors spit up blood. It was gratuitous in this series and was getting on my nerves. I get it, they spit up blood for anything. Shot in the arm? Gotta spit up blood. Stubbed your toe? Gotta spit up blood. Slipped on some ice into a pile of snow? Gotta spit up blood. It's so overdone at this point. Please China, I beg of you, calm it down. Bottom-line: It's worth a watch if you don't have anything else to do and you're a fan of the ML. I do suggest watching "The Maid" for a better story. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Night after night, she waits outside their room with water, ready to serve the young master and his consort. To escape the original fate and take revenge on behalf of the original Wu Er, Lin Wu seduces the young master while the consort sleeps and even positions the consort to face them. reviews.author: Silver-Bus
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers High Stakes Games Clothes and cars are 1920s, a unknown genius gambler appears shortly before the deciding tournament. It’s the gorgeous fl who approaches the Ninth Master (ml) for sponsorship.She wants revenge for her murdered father, the ml seeks revenge for his former mentor. Opposing forces, deceit, betrayal, hidden identities all in front of sumptuous interior sets.Immediately hooked by the classy outfits and sets, I loved the gambler and scam artist plot. First of all, the gambling involves cards, dice and mahjong. The last is translated as poker - why? only the translator knows. Because calling it “poker” doesn’t help understanding the rules. But it wasn’t relevant because it’s all about the sexual tension between the leads *who don’t trust each other and still feel the mutual attraction build*. They prepare for THE competition between ruthless gamblers for the crown as “King of Birds”. Underneath all this the fl risks everything to avenge her father, including killing the ml, if necessary. The ml has his own agenda to find the “Ghost Master” and if the fl should be the daughter of a traitor, he’ll use her first and kill her later.**Xie Yu Wang** is not only handsome but talented to boot. It’s a challenging role, physically- all these smart card and dice throws including using them as a weapon*.He’s so good at showing a man usually in total control of his emotions who fights the allure of the fl. She’s a talented and flamboyant beauty with a sharp mind. It was a great performance, I don’t know many actresses who would have pulled this off. She’s a character like Han Yu Tong in “Bloom in shadows” - but Sun Yiran adds much more sex appeal (think: Sharon Stone).Their chemistry was palpable. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.5 This review may contain spoilers The twists made this stolen identity story exciting until the very end I was preparing for a reddit post about Chinese vertical drama actors from Taiwan and decided to revisit Bai Yi Xiang's work even though I had seen 3 already. I picked this drama because I had only seen Zhai Cheng Lu in 1 drama. I must say this drama exceeded my expectation thanks to the writing.What I liked:1. Stolen identity - There was a good combination of elements to strengthen the stolen identity trope.2. Acting - I was impressed by Zhai Cheng Lu and Liu Yan Jun's performances. Contrasting style to make their different personas stand out. Bai Yi Xiang was also good in his role in comparison to his other dramas that I have seen. The actress who played mother to both sisters was good too.3. FL characterisation - She was calm, composed & kind. She was not an idle housewife - there were a few work scenes that showcased her capability at work. 4. Romance - There was sexual tension between FL and ML post-identity swap. There were sweet gestures by FL towards ML.5. Twists - I loved how the twists were presented in this drama. In most vertical dramas, the third act became flat after climax but this drama managed to keep my excitement and interest until the very end.6. Pacing - 2 hours 14 minute drama that is well-paced.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Si Yao was a jealous opportunist and manipulative. She saw an opportunity that could benefit her without much work and took it. Mr Lu was another opportunist who was smart enough to get entangled with Si Yao.2. FL's mother - Oh the twist! Her actions after finding out the truth frustrated me.3. Cheating - ML slept with FL when she was drunk and amnesiac because he felt a connection with her. Then he never came clean to his wife-to-be. It's just icky to me that he cheated even with this complicated stolen identity element.Favourite sceneWhen FL's mother revealed that she know about the stolen identity Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: zhugu_fu
reviews.review_text: Overall 1.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 1.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers the kind of series you finish only if you’re determined—never because it truly captivates you. Blossoming Affection had the potential to be a tender, courtly romance, but the execution fell short in several important areas. One of the biggest issues was the way the female lead—and even the supporting characters—seemed to completely overlook the etiquette and decorum expected when interacting with the imperial family. In a historical drama, this kind of cultural and behavioral accuracy is part of the charm, so when it’s ignored, it breaks immersion and makes the scenes feel careless rather than intentional.Production-wise, the drama also felt oddly empty. For a story set within the imperial sphere, the world-building was surprisingly thin. It almost felt like the entire narrative revolved around just two figures—the prince uncle and the 2nd prince—while everyone else faded into background noise. The lack of political depth, court dynamics, and wider family involvement made the palace feel more like a small household than an empire. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Shin
reviews.review_text: Overall 1.5 Story 1.5 Acting/Cast 3.5 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.5 A bumpkin and a general of lost memories I don’t know which prehistoric organism wrote this script, So apparently, the FL lives in some Parallel dimension magical forest . She finds the ML half-dead, rescues him, and fixes everything from his arrow wounds right down to his… technical difficulties. Eventually They fall in love, get married, and on the last day of their seven-day honeymoon, she literally sends him back to the mortal dimension with a good decisive push. And the man forgets her because that’s the rule he will forget everything as soon as he steps out of that magical realm and He’ll also feel pain every time it rains because… why not? Let’s add weather trauma too. A year later, she pops out again to “save him” from impending death #2, skipping all her duties and promises she made to protect her hometown. Cherries on the top she knows almost nothing about the mortal realm norms .. She can’t read, can’t write, but she’s out here with a ' I will save him' banner.And truly—how many times she saves this man? Once, twice, thrice? Even the destiny got tired let alone my PAITENCE. More importantly the prophecy said he will die with the first snow, but she was wasting energy saving him from random arrows in August. No logic. And the ML… useless. What general?? He got beaten up more times than the background soldiers. He has a literal walking time machine but won’t use it because “he doesn’t want her hurt.” Aww, cute. Meanwhile she’s saving him FIVE times because of his noble stupidity.Anyway. I dropped it at episode 14, and honestly … that was the best decision I made all day. title: You're Not Him
also_known_as: Ni Bu Shi Ta
synopsis: A married couple lives under the weight of a deeply unbalanced relationship, one plagued by emotional distance and the constant interference of the husband's former lover, who also happens to be the wife's sister. Bound by a harsh agreement, she endures quietly: he would only marry her if she promised to obey his every word, no matter the cost. But how long can this silence last, and when will he finally begin to see the pain he's caused? (Source: ASTER at MyDramaList; edited by MyDramaList) English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

reviews.author: Kitty
reviews.review_text: Overall 1.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 not impactful The story didn’t leave any impact on me. I didn’t feel love, hatred, or even sympathy for any of the characters. Not a single emotion stirred within me. Despite all the drama and revelations, none of the characters managed to connect with me on an emotional level.Story Summary:The male lead (ML) and female lead (FL) are a married couple, but their marriage is far from happy. Their relationship is constantly disrupted by ML's ex-girlfriend, who is none other than FL's own sister.FL silently endures all the pain and humiliation because their marriage was based on a cruel condition: ML agreed to marry her only if she promised to obey his every word, no matter what.It’s only when it's too late that ML realizes he has genuinely fallen in love with FL. But with this realization comes a heartbreaking truth, FL never loved him. In fact, she married him not for herself, but for the memory of someone else.Years ago, FL was in love with ML’s twin brother, who tragically died. His heart was transplanted into ML’s body, which is the only reason FL agreed to the marriage. She wasn't in love with ML, she was still holding on to the heart of the man she truly loved.ML’s mother has always despised FL, holding her responsible for the death of her beloved son. But the real truth is even darker: it was FL’s own sister, the same one who became ML's ex, who murdered ML’s twin. She did it out of envy because ML’s twin was about to propose to FL, and she couldn’t bear to see FL have something she couldn't.In the end, all the secrets come out. ML sacrifices his life to save FL, and dies knowing the whole truth. The story ends in tragedy, with love lost, truth revealed, and a heart once shared now gone forever. reviews.author: ZephyraBloom
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Not Flawless, But Worth the Watch – My Review of Everbloom Dynasty ✨The acting wasn’t bad — it fit the tone of the story, even if a few moments felt a little flat Also if you’re looking for something to watch then absolutely give it a try yet I think this drama wasn’t bad at the end while The story follows Yan Jiehuan, who comes back home after 17 years only to be framed for crimes she didn’t commit, and she even loses her father in the process. Instead of breaking down, she chooses to fight back, using her intelligence and determination to clear her name.Her path leads her into the depths of palace conspiracies, where she meets Prince Jing. Both of them carry pain from their pasts, yet through working together they uncover the truth behind betrayals and corruption. I really liked how their relationship grew — not just built on romance, but also on trust and support during struggles.The drama has its flaws, with some pacing that felt slow in the middle, but the characters and emotional depth made it worth watching. The ending left me with hope — even in such a harsh world, love and loyalty made all the difference.Overall, it’s a good mix of palace intrigue, resilience, and touching romance. Not perfect, but definitely memorable.✨ Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: SpillTheDramaTea
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 9.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 Everbloom Dynasty: Secrets Behind the Palace Walls 🔹 Would I rewatch? Yes, the short episodes make it easy to press play again✨ Ever tried a snack-sized palace drama where every scene drops you straight into suspicion and scheming?📕 Overview🔹 24 episodes, historical + romance + palace intrigue🔹 Not adapted from outside material🔹 Huang Yuzi as Yan Jiehuan: a wrongly accused heroine who uses her smarts to survive🔹 Sun Zihang as Liu An (Prince Jing): steady and loyal as her partner🔹 The story begins when Yan Jiehuan returns home for her father’s birthday, but is framed and ends up in the palace searching for the truth🔹 At the time of this review, all episodes have aired🔹 Perfect if you want a short palace drama with a wrongly accused heroine and just enough intrigue to keep you curious🌸 How It Felt Watching🔹 The first episodes jump right into action with accusations, interrogations, and an unexpected escape into palace life🔹 The pace is quick, like flipping through a mini mystery novel🔹 Themes: justice + loyalty + survival, with just a tiny hint of romance✨ Cast & Performances🔹 Huang Yuzi as Yan Jiehuan: quick-thinking, likable, and easy to root for🔹 Sun Zihang as Liu An: calm and steady, trustworthy as her partner🔹 Supporting characters added humor, loyalty, and bursts of tension to balance the palace intrigue🎵 OST 🎵🔹 No official OST confirmed yet; background score leans suspenseful and steady👉 If no OST is verified, omit this section in future updates🎞️ Production Style🔹 Sets are simple but visually clean, with bright interiors that work well even on a phone screen🔹 Costumes look classic and give a period feel without being over the top☕ Tea Notes🔹 What worked: quick pace, a clever heroine, and bite-sized episodes perfect for busy days🔹 What didn’t: short 10–15 minute episodes sometimes left little room for deeper emotions🔹 Would I rewatch? Yes, especially as a quick way to enjoy some palace drama between longer shows☕ SpillTheDramaTea’s Rating: 9/10 — a smooth cup, soothing yet rich in every sip✏️ As SpillTheDramaTea, I found it fun and easy to watch on the go💭 If you had to survive in the palace with only your quick thinking, would you last as long as Yan Jiehuan? The culprits are Song family and Qin family (one of major families) and FL want to take revenge by using ML as her weapon as she search about her parent real murder with using mirror to get her other personality. By time,She was fall in love with ML.Overall the story was quite complicated but somehow i got yawned on the middle so i tried to fast forward and the ending is quite niceRecommended to Zhang Sifan and Peng Yao fans. synopsis: Jiang Zhi Zhi transmigrates into the body of a vicious supporting female character. At this moment, the battlefield of love begins: the noble villain is pushed down by her, the brooding top student is punished to kneel in the bathroom, the proud childhood friend drugs her and hides her in a closet, and her fiancé, the crown prince of Beijing’s elite circle, walks in during the chaos. Her mission is to save herself—otherwise, she will face the men’s mad revenge and a tragic death. To complete the system’s tasks of boosting the main couple’s romance, she must flirt with both the male lead and male supporting characters across three plotlines, all while setting off Qiao Yan by contrast. Unexpectedly, she and the villain Pei He Nian both regain their memories, rekindling their old love. It turns out the system had a BUG—the two of them are the real central storyline. title: Seventy-Zero Nirvana Acacia and the Year of Brocade
complete_title: Seventy-Zero Nirvana Acacia and the Year of Brocade (2025)
sub_title: 七零涅槃刺槐与锦年 ‧ Drama ‧ 2025
also_known_as: Qi Ling Nie Pan Ci Huai Yu Jin Nian , 七零涅槃刺槐與錦年
synopsis: After sixteen years of a suffocating marriage, Su Qing La has endured enough. Her husband, Xiao Dou Guo, openly favors his "friend", the widow Shen Yu Fang, and her son. The final straw comes when he attempts to move the widow's son and his newlywed wife into their home. Su Qing La presents an ultimatum: remove them, or face divorce. When he refuses both, her rage culminates in a devastating fire that engulfs their house and everyone within it. In an incredible twist, Su Qing La is reborn at the pivotal age of twenty, just before her calamitous marriage. Armed with the painful knowledge of her past, she decisively breaks off her engagement to a manipulative fiancé and his conniving female associate. Seizing this extraordinary second chance, she returns to her family in the countryside, empowered by the miraculous "Mystical Space” — a gift that promises to reshape her entire existence. Her path soon converges with Gu Zhan, a man destined for remarkable wealth and influence. These encounters lay the groundwork for an empowering new chapter, where Su Qing La is committed not only to healing her past but to securing a future brimming with happiness, justice, and the possibility of genuine love. (Source: DramaChef at MyDramaList) English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어
