title: Love in the Twilight Breeze
also_known_as: Love in the Evening Wind and Stars , 戀於夕風星語間 , Love in the Evening Breeze
synopsis: As she nears forty, Jiang Xiao Yu desperately seeks to save her daughter from leukemia by selling her eggs. By accident, she dials the number of hospital director Jin Han Cheng, who, concerned for her well-being, pretends to scare her off from this dangerous path. However, fate has other plans as they unexpectedly share a passionate night together, resulting in an unplanned pregnancy. To support her unborn child, Jiang Xiao Yu takes a job at a nightclub, where she narrowly misses encountering Jin Han Cheng several times, and misunderstandings arise between them. Believing she has fallen into a life of depravity, Jin Han Cheng remains unaware of her struggles. Meanwhile, Jiang Xiao Yu and her daughter are harassed and abused by her gambling ex-husband, leaving their lives hanging by a thread. Just when all seems lost, Jin Han Cheng discovers the truth and, overwhelmed with guilt, rushes to their rescue. (Source: DramaWave YouTube) English Português (Brasil) Español 한국어

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 This review may contain spoilers A heartfelt romance between mature aged couple with ML looking like Dr McSteamy I was watching something on Youtube then an ad from Dramawave appeared. The guy was hot even though character was supposed to be middle aged man! I tried searching for the drama on reddit and then watched the drama in full. Wow, I was pleasantly surprised by drama because it was heartfelt. This drama definitely goes to my 'watch on repeat' list.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - The first scene reminded me of A Night Deeply Drunk on the Spring Breeze. FL was trying to sell eggs to a doctor as a desperate attempt to get big money but in this drama, FL was less damsel in distress. I was floored by her kindness and authenticity. Pan Yiyi was excellent in her role.2. Romance - Damn this romance involves 2 mature age individuals (past 35 years old) and they were hot! Their intimate scenes were hot and tastefully done. I could sense the lust and desire they had for each other. That advice about intimate relations during pregnancy was much appreciated! In addition, I loved that this couple was affectionate. They held hands & spent quality time with each other. I was moved when FL felt cherished by ML3. ML characterisation - I think ML is the type of person who never thought about love but once he has felt the possibility of loving and being loved, he wants to get hold of it. I liked that he was committed to making their relationship work. This was my first time watching Sa Gang Yun and wow, he impressed me. Looks wise, he gave me the vibe of Dr McSteamy of Grey's Anatomy.4. Supporting characters - I really liked ML's sister and grandma although I was irritated by grandma's silly question close to the ending. I also liked FL's daughter though wish she would make an appearance during the ending.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Damn, FL's ex husband was a vile person! There was also green tea who tried her best to bring down FL but luckily her attempts were unsuccessful.2. Abuse - FL suffered so much but I am delighted that she found a way out of those situations.Favourite sceneWhen ML celebrated FL's birthday Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Amor forçado & dark romance. Vemos isso em tantos, mas por que as críticas aqui são pesadas? Esse drama é uma mescla entre amor forçado e dark romance, porque a FL é constantemente manipulada, chantageada e coagida seja pelo ML, sua família adotiva e seu noivo arranjado.A FL inicialmente procura o 2ML, mas acaba encontrando o ML, que a ama em segredo (a vá né), mas ele a pressiona a ter uma relação ambígua, enquanto ela é noiva de seu tio, que depois que a chantageia emocionalmente para manter o noivado por causa do orfanato. Vemos isso em diversos dramas, mas por que as críticas aqui são pesadas?Não sei responder ao certo, mas em outros dramas, em suma maioria, quando é apenas dark romance, a FL se interessa pelo ML genuinamente no início, seja uma atração física ou o que. Enquanto no amor forçado, não, mas geralmente segue-se aquele roteiro que ela se sensibiliza pelo ML nos primeiros 30 minutos, enquanto vemos isso como "menos pior". Aqui a FL é resistente constantemente, todos os beijos são forçados, todas as interações entre a FL e o ML é porque ele a coagiu e perseguiu. Mesmo quando ela descobre que ele é o menino de mil anos atrás (a vá 2), não há sinceridade por parte dela em dizer o que está acontecendo. Mas também talvez seja pela falta de química entre os atores, porque a história não é original, há tantas outras com comentários bem melhores e com tópicos até piores do que este. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers Hidden Gem in Short drama I actually watched this drama last November and rewatch this again for better review.FL is naturally resolute, kind, and highly skilled in martial arts. However, in an era that treats women as worthless, she is trapped as a slave in the home of a local wealthy man. I quite like Wang Gege in this drama she is perfect for this role.Female power is perfectly embodied. The women in the play initially chose to bow down and compromise and trample their self-esteem underfoot because of the shackles of the era they lived in. However, after being encouraged by FL's perseverance, they chose to take up arms to fight for themselves and their country. Nice!Plot is about FL is framed for treason due to her sister's jealousy and conspiracy, After her home is affected by the Japanese pirate invasion, she leads the female slaves in her household and the women of the village to take up arms to defend their homeland, relying on three hairpins symbolizing kinship and vows. ML is carefree person in surface but is actually a funder for a civilian anti-Japanese pirate organization, constantly using his own strength to fight the enemy. I quite like Cai Xin Yang in this drama although the costume was quite simple it embodies his character well. I love this drama since they make our lead to become platonic combo that have one vision without adding romance.Hopefully, screenwriters in Chinese short drama can gather information on cultural heritage and create a powerful female ensemble drama without focusing on romance.Recommended to watch. reviews.author: ShibaniD1961
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 Heroine-centric action Imu’s Three Knives” is a standout vertical short drama powered by compelling performances from Wang Ge Ge and Cai Xin Yang. Their chemistry is strong, the pacing is tight, and each storyline tied to the three hairpins.Wang Ge Ge delivers a beautifully layered performance—calm on the surface, turbulent underneath—while Cai Xin Yang complements her perfectly with grounded, natural acting. Together, they elevate “Imu’s Three Knives” into a short drama that hits far deeper than expected. Wang Ge Ge is absolutely stunning in this and Cai Xin Yang matches her energy so well! Their dynamic gives the drama so much tension and heart.Great chemistry, tight pacing, beautiful visuals, To be honest this vertical drama surprised me and its nothing cliched like we are used to seeing this is genre. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Angst & tension - this is a love story that stood the test of time I was in the mood for Shi Yue Yue dramas so I decided to watch this drama. I didn't expect this drama to be full of angst and tension but overall it was a good watch.Trigger warning: Mental health issue, Suicide attemptWhat I liked:1. Romance - Childhood sweethearts who broke up due to FL's unsavoury situation. When they were not together as a couple, the tension was high. When they reunited, they were burning with passion. Some sweet moments - when they gave cheek peck or quick kiss.2. Acting - Fantastic chemistry with great performances by both of them.3. Family - Core theme. FL's grandmother, FL's parents, ML's brother.4. FL characterisation - I liked that she's hardworking & troed her best to protect her grandma & mother.5. ML characterisation - I likee that he provided support to FL intuitively.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's father was dead but left a haunting presence. Unfortunately FL got harrassed by loan sharks because her father never settled his debts.2. ML's action - I didn't like when he shoved his younger bro. He wasn't at fault for their father's wrongdoings.Favourite sceneWhen ML found out about what truly happened to FL Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: PhD student Luo Qing Zhou accidentally travels through time and becomes the illegitimate son of a noble family in Chengguo. His mother is killed, and he is forced to marry into the Qin family as a live-in son-in-law, wedding a simple-minded bride. Tested by his mother-in-law, Luo Qing Zhou impresses her on the spot with his poetry. After the marriage, he wins her favor through his literary talent by day, while secretly training in martial arts under a mysterious woman. When he is framed and attacked while exterminating bandits, the only clue he has left is a silk ribbon belonging to that mysterious woman. (Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Jia Niang Zi, Bu Dui Jin" (我家娘子，不对劲) by Yi Chan Zhi Xia (一蝉知夏). English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

also_known_as: Double Face Plan , 雙顏計
synopsis: Lin Wan, daughter of renowned doctor Lin Zhong, loses her family in a massacre orchestrated by Shen Zhao Ran, a high-ranking noblewoman, who fears her secret pregnancy might be exposed. Determined to seek revenge, Lin Wan undergoes surgery to resemble Shen Zhao Ran and infiltrates her household under the alias Xia Rong. While impersonating her, she is sent to the Southern King’s manor and survives an assassination attempt. Her medical skills earn the king’s admiration, but also provoke Shen Zhao Ran’s jealousy and humiliation. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Plausible yet unconventional drama I watched this drama yesterday since i found the proper subtitle for this drama. If you are looking for entertainment or romance drama, this is not for you. If you look for unconventional plot, you can give this drama a try, Huang Yunyun nailed the female role this time and its my first time seeing Hou Pengyan in ancient drama. The supporting casts are doing great job and my personal favorite were FL's bodyguard and FL maid.The plot is basically about FL who got second chance after being murdered by her husband who pretended to died with his mistress but the difference she just do any improvisation since she had no clue beside the time before her death. She was tricked by her Mother-in law few times while she want to change her fate without her knowing. The scumbag and mistress commit suicide and die together in the early stages, and the divorce is decided very early on. Later, FL fights with the ML against the emperor, the supervisor, and the imperial concubine. In the end, the couple works together to ascend the throne. Palace Let's go to most controversial. Many people say that the FL was reborn for nothing, but in my opinion, she didn't even touch the core of this matter in her previous life. Given her position, she has already done her best for example she knew she couldn't change her mother hatred for her. FL also tried to fix ML fate few times even when he was exiled she stayed by his side.The cons in this drama were editing and story coherence are flawed; there's too much content, and the flow isn't very smooth .There is much plot hole for the example ML repeatedly abandoned the FL for Consort Xiao, and the reasons for his kindness towards her were never clearly explained, which infuriated me.You can this drama try if you want to see unconventional drama. reviews.author: p_s
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers ESH - I know nobody asked, but ESH FL - She was a power hungry, manipulative person. It doesn't seem like she genuinely cared for the ML or anyone other than becoming Crown Princess/Queen. SFL - Equally manipulative. Willingly killer her handmaiden when blackmailed. ML - Easily manipulated, fickle with his affection - first loves SFL but quickly falls for FL. SML - I actually really liked him. He cared about the FL, didn't try to manipulate her feelings. Yes, he tried to force her hand into marrying him, and it played in favour of the FL's machinations, but other than that, his affection seemed genuine and did not come with strings attached. I love the message that there is nothing like pre-determined destiny, and that we make our own destiny, but this was not the way to do it. FL was not a good person. And I have never wanted a group of people to not end up with anyone more than I did this group. Everyone was a jerk. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Like the ending, Yang Luo Qian and Chen Zheng Yang delivers their role. I watched this drama and surprisingly i liked this drama despite how infuriating the plot was. Yang Luo Qian loves this script since most of her dramas i watch are FL was being hurt by scumbag. But this drama showcase her acting more than her previous drama.From FL's perspective, the story shows ML repeatedly abandoning her for SFL and their child. Plot is about FL tries every means to get a divorce, ML always finds various excuses to disagree. FL discovers she's pregnant, but by then she's already given up on him, so she has an abortion and insists on a divorce (quite controversial but i prefer her to abort the baby, if she keep the baby ML would be manipulated her again). ML finally confesses to her that he and SFL are innocent, and that the child isn't his. However, the damage has already been done, and FL doesn't forgive him. ML realizes his mistakes and ultimately chooses to let go. It's a classic case of regret from scumbag. But the difference in this drama, there is no SML to 'heal' FL. FL is doing this alone by herself. Although FL is indeed deeply hurt and evokes sympathy, she remains clear-headed and resolute throughout, determined to get a divorce without any wavering, which is quite satisfying to watch.Chen Zheng Yang was really ultimate scumbag in here, i hated him in here. Even though ML really loves ML emotional infidelity was unacceptable. From the very beginning, when ML abandoned FL for the 'test' to pick up SFL FL refused to accept it. If FL had tolerated it this time, what awaited her was being morally blackmailed and forced to tolerate ML's behavior in every way. These low-down behaviors of the ML are no better than physical infidelity. The only redeeming point from ML, he is not abusing SFL and the child like another type of this drama. All the misunderstandings were his own doing, and ML deserves the consequences.Overall only recommended for Hardcore fans Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 1.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers ML. P O D R E ! Meu Deus, que ML P O D R E !O cara simplesmente mente por 2 horas e 40 minutos, sempre com aquele discurso, confie em mim, quando chegarmos em casa a gente conversa, humilhando a FL jurando amor pela 2FL e seu filho para o avô dele para então tudo ser revelado quando a FL aborta o filho que espera dele.A cunhada da FL é a única que presta na família, assim como a sua família materna que a apoia. O ML diz tanto amar a FL e a humilha financeiramente, falando que se ela quer o divórcio, é para devolver 1 bilhão que ele pagou nas dívidas da família dela, porque sabe que ela não conseguiria o dinheiro de maneira fácil e ainda tem a capacidade de dizer que ela o ama muito, por isso confiará nele, sendo que em momento algum ele faz por merecer.Gostei do posicionamento da FL, que não se deixou abater pelos sentimentos de 20 anos e 3 de casamento, ela foi enfática em sua decisão e lutou com unhas e dentes por isso, enquanto isso o ML só se preocupava com a reputação da família, em não se divorciar e defender a ex-namorada e o filho dela. Ou seja o filha da puta quer tudo né? Me poupe. Nota 1. Passei raiva e olha que eu assisti na velocidade máxima no youtube porque o drama é intragável. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 6.5 This review may contain spoilers 7ª adaptação do plot 2ML traiu 52 vezes kkkk Das 8 adaptações lançadas só não assisti a uma, mas houveram algumas que esqueci de fazer resenha e esta de marcar como assistida também kkkkSinceramente nenhuma supera a Fu Rong Hua Kai Dai Jun Zhe (4ª adaptação lançada) com o ator Zhang Bei Xi e a atriz Liu Ying, a química explosiva deles foi insana! Aqui os atores principais foram bem nos beijos, porém parecia que a atriz Xin Run Qian controlava a intensidade dos beijos com os dedos, em muitas cenas foi possível perceber o movimento da mão dela no rosto do ator, não só mostrando uma certa ingenuidade de sua personagem. Eu gosto do Zhuo Hang apesar de ter visto poucos dramas com ele.Essa adaptação é um pouco mais detalhista em algumas situações do que as outras, e também enrola em uns pontos que não precisaria tanto empenho. Mas eu gargalhei alto com o véu tosco da FL quando ela se torna a cantora kkkkkkkk É bizarro, só as miçanguinhas ou o véu quase transparente, não sei nem porque a produção se deu ao trabalho de colocar aquilo nela kkkkkO figurino dos principais eram limitados, porém bonitos, mas nem todos cheongsams valorizavam o corpo da atriz, apenas o branco, não foi a toa que ela passou quase o drama todo com ele kkkkkkk Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers Longtime crush, assumptions & green tea shenanigans with sizzling chemistry from the leads I didn't know Han Jia Hui has worked with Wang Zilin twice until I checked his list of new releases. This drama's video title caught my attention because it implied FL had relations with ML's father. It did feel weird but overall this was a good drama.What I liked:1. Romance - The push & pull dynamics was done very well. Their interactions at the start of the drama were explosive & playful (that sneaky kiss while ML's father in the room) but gradually developed depth as the story progressed. They became emotionally connected once they overcame a hurdle in their relationship.2. Acting - Han Jia Hui has grown so much (Have Babies is my first drama of hers and I love her there). In here, she showcased different façades of her character. Wang Zi Lin was great in his role and matched intensity of Han Jia Hui's acting.3. FL characterisation - Despite all the scheming & tough exterior, she was a vilnerable woman. I loved that she was willing to risk her life to save ML. 4. Supporting characters - I liked FL's bestie (she kicked ass!), ML's bestie (he looked so familiar) & assistant. The gangster boss was handsome!5. Gift - There was birthday party of an elder and I liked FL's personalised gift. 6. Styling - I loved the clothes worn by Han Jia Hui & Wang Zi Lin.7. The ending - I wasn't expecting it to be funny and that surprise guest in FL's entourage was a pleasant surprise.What I disliked:1. Communication - I wish they confessed to each other at the start of their marriage so there was no misunderstanding based on assumptions. 2. Antagonists - I disliked people that take credit for something they didn't do. I also disliked people who answered someone's phone without permission. She overstepped boundaries. Favourite sceneWhen FL was desperate to get out of dangerous situation & called ML for help Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: uchikattana
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 4.5 Rewatch Value 1.0 Don't bother First time I gave a vertical show a chance and it was a complete let down. I only finished it because it's 1,5h long. The story is very confusing in the beginning - I still don't really get why ML had to disguise himself as college student. The love story is meh. It's there but why she was even interested in him, I will never know. The plot in general was nothing interesting or sophisticated but what do you expect from these 2 min episodes vertical shows.The overall production quality was low budget but my highlight was FL's acting and her wardrobe. Honestly the only good parts about the whole show. I could definitely see her in more serious acting gigs. Her father is a financial tycoon, her mother an internationally acclaimed film queen, and her brother a genius prodigy. Only she is utterly ordinary, an unmistakable underachiever. reviews.author: geezette
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 10 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers A bit of a sleeper. I almost passed this up, but I wanted to watch enough to verify cast/character info. And then I couldn't stop watching. Others might not share my enthusiasm, but I loved this one. For me, it's a best possible comedic parody on the real versus fake daughter, swapped babies, rich family, hidden identity themes without the incessant yapping, bias blindness, cruelty, etcetera. I think they had to have managed to hit most every trope? Perfect "cartoon" graphics. Great casting & performances! Happy ending: Wishes fulfilled, lost loves reunited, a family finds its hearts. Even a bonus reveal: Argentina (think Africa), BECAUSE it's the place that's "the farthest away". Made me smile, grin, giggle, chuckle, laugh, face palm... (Spoiler: Be ready. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Cast: Eu gostei muito da atriz Wang Lin Hui, espero que logo ela tenha uma página aqui no MDL para podermos cadastrar seus dramas, são poucos, mas suas personagens são boas. Já o Gao Wei, o que eu posso dizer? kkkkk Eu tenho um ranço da cara dele porque ainda não superei a adaptação "Lian Nian Bu Wang" hahahahah e toda vez que vejo algum drama com ele, ele é um canalha ou um homem que não merece nada kkkkkkFL: Eu simplesmente AMEI a FL e sua firmeza. Assim que percebeu que o seu marido já estava corrompido pela empatia com a criança e a 2FL e que sua certidão com ele era falsa, ela simplesmente cortou relações com ele e toda sua família. Sua postura firme, analisando friamente cada comportamento dele e fazendo a leitura perfeita ao ser importunada 5 anos depois foi fantástica (em 1 hora e 08 minutos). Minha nota é totalmente influenciada pela FL, porque finalmente era uma mulher forte. ML: Sua postura e suas ações falavam por si, ele apenas negava e fingia para si mesmo. Ele não a amava, apenas não aceitava que ela não precisasse dele, que não era fraca ou dependente, por isso se apegou tanto a 2FL, porque ela sim era fácil de ser enganada. O 2ML é interessante, mas confesso que não fiz muitas anotações sobre ele rs Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Great first & second acts but third act ruined by unnecessary drama I am a massive Huang Bo fan so I was excited to watch this drama when it was released. The drama started off with a bang with exciting first and second acts but seemed to run out of steam in the third act. Overall I enjoyed this drama.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was bubbly & flirty. Smart to approach ML for a safe space.2. Romance - I liked the pacing from the start because of the banter between the leads. Good kisses with sexy intimate scenes. Hand-holding was sweet.3. ML characterisation - He was prickly and sickly but warmed up to FL after her countless attempts to be nice to him. I liked that he strived to improve his leg condition. He also knew his boundaries with other women.4. Supporting characters - I liked Qin secretary and ML's mother.5. Styling - I wrote a reddit article about ML wearing black pleather jacket, white shirt, black tie & black trousers before this drama was released. Turned out Huang Bo too had worn this ensemble. I also liked FL's beautiful clothes.6. Acting - I enjoyed Mai Tong & Huang Bo performances. They had good chemistry even though it wasn't fiery nor sizzling.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - ML's father & half-bro were the worst people in this drama. FL's family was horrible too. ML's ex girlfriend was pathetic.2. ML's mother's action - Apparently the green tea saved ML mother's life. Asking ML to check on green tea's wellbeing crossed the line. She shouldn't feel obligated to fulfill green tea's request.3. Third act - It became messy after Qin announcement. How I wish the writer had focused on Qin heir situation than on emotional cheating (FL hung out with a man at a club which I considered emotional cheating). Why ruined the good, stable relationship between FL and ML with this scenario???Favourite sceneWhen ML worked hard on his leg treatment Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers Finally found Gao Ming drama that I enjoyed - him as a "vampire" I am a fan of supernatural themed vertical dramas. I got to know about this drama from subreddit CShortDramas. I watched it a few weeks before Halloween and I enjoyed it. I musy say that this drama is better than Liu Lan Bo's vampire drama.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was kind and soft-hearted but wasn't naive to the point of sacrificial lamb.2. Romance - Both genuinely liked each other but too bad bad events separated them. When they were together, they were sweet. I liked that FL wasn't shy about intimacy. 3. ML characterisation - I liked his protective nature. I also liked that he did his best to atone for his family's bad deeds.4. Supernatural - He wasn't quite a vampire - it was more like a curse that fell on his family. I liked this plot device.5. Supporting characters - I liked ML's assistant and the housekeeper.6. Acting - Good performances by the cast. I also liked the chemistry between Gao Ming and the main actress. I finally found a Gao Ming drama I enjoyed. What I disliked:1. Antagonists - SFL Lola was batshit crazy. She did everything she could to get ML including harming FL. FL's university rival was silly & annoying. I also disliked ML's grandfather and cousin / rival. The family doctor was horrible too for being an accomplice.2. Communication - I hated that ML distanced himself from FL because he believed the family doctor's advice. He should have discussed with FL instead.Favourite sceneWhen FL came to rescue ML at a hotel Read More Was this review helpful to you?
